meaning: n. the trait of lacking restraint or control; reckless freedom from inhibition or worry; v. forsake, leave behind; v. give up with the intent of never claiming again; v. stop maintaining or insisting on; of ideas or claims
translation_zh: vt. 放弃, 抛弃, 遗弃, 使屈从, 沉溺, 放纵；n. 放任, 无拘束, 狂热
example: We need to abandon this carefully.

meaning: n. the quality of being able to perform; a quality that permits or facilitates achievement or accomplishment; n. possession of the qualities (especially mental qualities) required to do something or get something done
translation_zh: n. 能力, 才干；[经] 能力, 才能
example: She has a great ability to learn new languages.

meaning: a. (usually followed by `to') having the necessary means or skill or know-how or authority to do something; s. have the skills and qualifications to do things well; s. having inherent physical or mental ability or capacity; s. having a strong healthy body
translation_zh: a. 能干的, 能够的
example: I am able to help you.

meaning: a. not normal; not typical or usual or regular or conforming to a norm; a. departing from the normal in e.g. intelligence and development; s. much greater than the normal
translation_zh: a. 反常的, 不规则的, 变态的, 畸形的；n. 畸形的人
example: They thought his behaviour was abnormal.

meaning: r. on a ship, train, plane or other vehicle; r. on first or second or third base; r. side by side; r. part of a group
translation_zh: adv. 在船上, 在火车上, 在飞机上；prep. 在...之上
example: All passengers are now aboard the flight.

meaning: n. a dark-skinned member of a race of people living in Australia when Europeans arrived
translation_zh: n. 土著, 土著居民, 土人
example: The aborigine was important for everyone.

meaning: n. an earlier section of a written text; s. appearing earlier in the same text; r. at an earlier place; r. in or to a place that is higher
translation_zh: prep. 在上方, 超出；adv. 在上面；a. 上述的, 上面的
example: The water came above our knees.

meaning: n. the state of being absent; n. failure to be present; n. the time interval during which something or somebody is away; n. the occurrence of an abrupt, transient loss or impairment of consciousness (which is not subsequently remembered), sometimes with light twitching, fluttering eyelids, etc.; common in petit mal epilepsy
translation_zh: n. 缺席, 缺乏, 没有；[医] 失神
example: Her absence was noted by the teacher.

meaning: v. go away or leave; a. not being in a specified place; s. lost in thought; showing preoccupation
translation_zh: a. 缺席的, 不在的, 缺乏的, 漫不经心的；vt. 使缺席
example: She was absent from school due to illness.

meaning: r. completely and without qualification; used informally as intensifiers; r. totally and definitely; without question
translation_zh: adv. 完全地, 绝对地, 确确实实地
example: I absolutely agree with you.

meaning: v. become imbued; v. take up mentally; v. take up, as of debts or payments; v. take in, also metaphorically
translation_zh: vt. 吸收, 使全神贯注, 同化, 买进, 理解, 承受, 忍受, 承担；[医] 吸收
example: The sponge can absorb a lot of water.

meaning: v. consider a concept without thinking of a specific example; consider abstractly or theoretically; v. consider apart from a particular case or instance; v. give an abstract (of); a. existing only in the mind; separated from embodiment
translation_zh: a. 抽象的, 深奥的；n. 摘要, 抽象概念；vt. 摘要, 提炼, 使抽象化；[计] 摘录; 摘要; 抽象
example: The research shows that pre-school children are capable of thinking in abstract terms.

meaning: n. the property of a more than adequate quantity or supply; n. (physics) the ratio of the number of atoms of a specific isotope of an element to the total number of isotopes present; n. (chemistry) the ratio of the total mass of an element in the earth's crust to the total mass of the earth's crust; expressed as a percentage or in parts per million
translation_zh: n. 丰富, 充足, 大量；[经] 丰富, 充裕
example: The brochure promised beautiful walks with an abundance of wildlife.

meaning: a. present in great quantity
translation_zh: a. 丰富的, 充分的, 大量的
example: Fish are abundant in the lake.

meaning: n. distinctive manner of oral expression; n. a diacritical mark used to indicate stress or placed above a vowel to indicate a special pronunciation
translation_zh: n. 重音, 口音, 特点, 注重点；vt. 重读, 加重音号于, 强调
example: She has a strong French accent.

meaning: n. the state of being acceptable and accepted; n. (contract law) words signifying consent to the terms of an offer (thereby creating a contract); n. banking: a time draft drawn on and accepted by a bank; n. the act of taking something that is offered
translation_zh: n. 接受, 接纳, 承认, 同意, 赞同, 容忍, 相信；[经] 承兑, 认付, (工程)验收
example: Her acceptance of the award was met with applause.

meaning: n. the right to obtain or make use of or take advantage of something (as services or membership); n. a way of entering or leaving; n. a code (a series of characters or digits) that must be entered in some way (typed or dialed or spoken) to get the use of something (a telephone line or a computer or a local area network etc.); n. (computer science) the operation of reading or writing stored information
translation_zh: n. 通路, 入口, 接近, 进入, 使用权, 发作；vt. 访问, 存取, 接近, 使用；[计] 访问, 存取
example: You need a key to gain access to the building.

meaning: a. capable of being reached; s. capable of being read with comprehension; s. easily obtained; s. easy to get along with or talk to; friendly
translation_zh: a. 易接近的, 可进入的, 可使用的, 易受影响的, 可理解的
example: The remote desert area is accessible only by helicopter.

meaning: n. clothing that is worn or carried, but not part of your main clothing; n. a supplementary component that improves capability; n. someone who helps another person commit a crime; s. furnishing added support
translation_zh: n. 附件, 零件, 附加物, 从犯, 同谋；a. 附属的, 补充的, 同谋的, 帮凶的, 非主要的, 副的；[计] 附件
example: We stock a large range of bicycle accessories.

meaning: n. a musical notation that makes a note sharp or flat or natural although that is not part of the key signature; s. happening by chance or unexpectedly or unintentionally
translation_zh: a. 意外的, 偶然的, 非主要的, 附属的；n. 临时记号, 次要方面
example: It was an accidental discovery.

meaning: r without advance planning; r of a minor or subordinate nature; r without intention; in an unintentional manner
translation_zh: adv. 偶然地, 意外地
example: I accidentally spilled coffee on my shirt.

meaning: v. go or travel along with
translation_zh: vt. 陪伴, 伴随, 补充, 为...伴奏；vi. 伴奏, 伴唱
example: She agreed to accompany him to the party.

meaning: v put in effect; v to gain with effort
translation_zh: vt. 完成, 达到, 实现, 使完美
example: We need to accomplish this carefully.

meaning: according to
translation_zh: 根据, 按照；取决于；据…所说
example: According to Mick, it's a great movie.

meaning: n. a formal contractual relationship established to provide for regular banking or brokerage or business services; n. importance or value; n. a statement of recent transactions and the resulting balance; n. the quality of taking advantage
translation_zh: n. 报告, 解释, 估价, 理由, 利润, 算账, 帐目；vi. 报帐, 解释, 导致, 报偿, 占, 杀死；vt. 认为；[计] 帐户, 帐号
example: I need to open a bank account.

meaning: n. someone who maintains and audits business accounts
translation_zh: n. 会计人员, 会计师；[经] 会计师, 会计人员
example: My accountant helps me with my taxes every year.

meaning: n. the quality of being near to the true value; n. (mathematics) the number of significant figures given in a number
translation_zh: n. 精确, 正确；[计] 准确度
example: They questioned the accuracy of the information in the file.

meaning: a. conforming exactly or almost exactly to fact or to a standard or performing with total accuracy; s. (of ideas, images, representations, expressions) characterized by perfect conformity to fact or truth; strictly correct
translation_zh: a. 正确的, 精确的；[经] 准确的, 精确的
example: Please provide accurate information.

meaning: r. with few mistakes; r. strictly correctly
translation_zh: adv. 正确地, 精确地
example: She spoke accurately during the meeting.

meaning: v. bring an accusation against; level a charge against
translation_zh: vt. 指责, 控告, 归咎于；vi. 指责, 控告
example: We need to accuse this carefully.

meaning: v make psychologically or physically used (to something)
translation_zh: vt. 使习惯于
example: We need to accustom this carefully.

meaning: n. a dull persistent (usually moderately intense) pain; v. have a desire for something or someone who is not present; v. be the source of pain
translation_zh: n. 疼痛；vi. 痛, 哀怜, 渴望
example: I'm aching all over.

meaning: v. to gain with effort
translation_zh: vt. 完成, 达到；vi. 如愿以偿
example: She worked hard to achieve her goals.

meaning: n the action of accomplishing something
translation_zh: n. 完成, 成就, 功业
example: Winning the award was a great achievement.

meaning: v. report the receipt of; v. express obligation, thanks, or gratitude for; v. accept as legally binding and valid; v. accept (someone) to be what is claimed or accept his power and authority
translation_zh: vt. 承认, 告知收悉, 答谢, 报偿；[经] 承认, 答谢, 收到的通知
example: We need to acknowledge this carefully.

meaning: n the state or quality of being recognized or acknowledged; n a statement acknowledging something or someone
translation_zh: n. 承认, 确认, 感谢, 收到的通知；[计] 确认; 肯定
example: This report is an acknowledgement of the size of the problem.

meaning: n. a statement acknowledging something or someone
translation_zh: n. 承认, 答谢, 认可, 谢礼, 收到的通知, 收到的回音, 谢意；[计] 肯定, 确认认可
example: The acknowledgment was important for everyone.

meaning: n. personal knowledge or information about someone or something; n. a relationship less intimate than friendship; n. a person with whom you are acquainted
translation_zh: n. 认识, 相识者
example: She is an old acquaintance from college.

meaning: v. locate (a moving entity) by means of a tracking system such as radar; v. win something through one's efforts
translation_zh: vt. 获得, 学到；[电] 目标锁定
example: We need to acquire this carefully.

meaning: n. a female actor
translation_zh: n. 女演员
example: The Oscar-winning actress has taken a break from acting.

meaning: a. presently existing in fact and not merely potential or possible; s. taking place in reality; not pretended or imitated; s. being or reflecting the essential or genuine character of something; s. existing in act or fact
translation_zh: a. 真实的, 实际的, 现行的；[医] 实际死亡率
example: The actual cost was higher than we expected.

meaning: r. in actual fact; r. used to imply that one would expect the fact to be the opposite of that stated; surprisingly; r. at the present moment; r. as a sentence modifier to add slight emphasis
translation_zh: adv. 事实上, 竟然, 如今, 现在
example: I actually forgot my keys.

meaning: n. a public promotion of some product or service; r. in the Christian era; used before dates after the supposed year Christ was born
translation_zh: n. 广告；[计] 地址, 模拟-数字
example: I saw an interesting ad for a new car.

meaning: v. make fit for, or change to suit a new purpose
translation_zh: vt. 使适应, 改编；vi. 适应
example: It takes time to adapt to a new culture.

meaning: n. a component that is added to something to improve it; n. the act of adding one thing to another; n. a quantity that is added; n. a suburban area laid out in streets and lots for a future residential area
translation_zh: n. 加法, 增加的人(或物)；[计] 加法
example: In addition to the main course, we had dessert.

meaning: s further or added
translation_zh: a. 附加的, 另外的, 额外的；[机] 加添的, 附加的
example: Do you need any additional information?

meaning: n. one to whom something is addressed
translation_zh: n. 收件人, 收信人；[经] 台头人, 收信人
example: The addressee was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a feeling of delighted approval and liking; n. a favorable judgment
translation_zh: n. 赞赏, 钦佩, 引人赞赏的对象
example: She expressed her admiration for his courage.

meaning: n. the act of admitting someone to enter; n. an acknowledgment of the truth of something
translation_zh: n. 准许进入, 入场费, 录用, 承认；[经] 加入, 入股
example: Admission to the museum is free on Tuesdays.

meaning: v. declare to be true or admit the existence or reality or truth of; v. allow to enter; grant entry to; v. allow participation in or the right to be part of; permit to exercise the rights, functions, and responsibilities of; v. afford possibility
translation_zh: vt. 承认, 接受, 允许进入, 容许；vi. 开向, 容许, 承认
example: He had to admit he was wrong.

meaning: v. choose and follow; as of theories, ideas, policies, strategies or plans; v. take up and practice as one's own; v. take into one's family
translation_zh: vt. 采用, 正式通过, 收养, 接受；[医] 采取
example: They decided to adopt a child.

meaning: s. lovable especially in a childlike or naive way
translation_zh: a. 可崇拜的, 值得敬慕的, 可爱的
example: The puppy was absolutely adorable.

meaning: n. an amount paid before it is earned; n. increase in price or value; v. move forward, also in the metaphorical sense; v. bring forward for consideration or acceptance
translation_zh: n. 前进, 进展, 行过的路程；vi. 前进, 进展, 提高, 上涨；vt. 使前进, 促进, 提出, 提高, 使提前, 预付；a. 前面的, 预先的
example: The army began to advance towards the enemy.

meaning: n. the quality of having a superior or more favorable position; n. (tennis) first point scored after deuce; n. benefit resulting from some event or action; v. give an advantage to
translation_zh: n. 优点, 便利, 好处, 优势；vt. 有助于
example: Having a car is a great advantage.

meaning: n. the word class that qualifies verbs or clauses; n. a word that modifies something other than a noun
translation_zh: n. 副词
example: The word 'quickly' is an adverb.

meaning: n. a word or group of words function as an adverb; a. of or relating to or functioning as an adverb
translation_zh: a. 副词的, 状语的；n. 状语
example: This is a very adverbial situation.

meaning: n a public promotion of some product or service; v give heed (to); v make a more or less disguised reference to; v make reference to
translation_zh: vi. 提出看法, 引起注意, 留意；n. 广告
example: I saw an advert for a new car.

meaning: v. call attention to; v. make publicity for; try to sell (a product)
translation_zh: vt. 做广告, 通知, 公布；vi. 做广告
example: Companies advertise their products on TV.

meaning: n. the business of drawing public attention to goods and services
translation_zh: n. 广告业, 广告；a. 广告的；[计] 发广告
example: The company spends a lot on advertising.

meaning: n. a proposal for an appropriate course of action
translation_zh: n. 忠告, 劝告, 意见, 报道, 通知；[经] 通知书, 通知, 建议
example: Can you give me some advice?

meaning: n. an expert who gives advice
translation_zh: n. 顾问, 劝告者, 指导教师；[法] 顾问, 劝告者
example: She consulted her financial adviser.

meaning: n an expert who gives advice
translation_zh: n. 顾问, 劝告者, 指导教师
example: She consulted her financial advisor.

meaning: n. exercise that increases the need for oxygen
translation_zh: n. 有氧运动法；增氧健身法
example: The aerobics was important for everyone.

meaning: n. the conscious subjective aspect of feeling or emotion; v. have an effect upon; v. act physically on; have an effect upon; v. have an emotional or cognitive impact upon
translation_zh: vt. 影响, 感动, 假装, 模仿, 爱好, 倾向于；n. 自觉感情
example: The weather can affect your mood.

meaning: n. a positive feeling of liking
translation_zh: n. 影响, 病, 喜爱, 情感, 倾向；[医] 疾患, 病变, 病; 感情
example: She showed great affection for her grandchildren.

meaning: v. be able to spare or give up; v. have the financial means to do something or buy something; v. afford access to
translation_zh: vt. 买得起, 足以, 给予
example: I can't afford a new car right now.

meaning: r happening at a time subsequent to a reference time
translation_zh: adv. 然后, 后来
example: We went to the cinema and afterward we had dinner.

meaning: r happening at a time subsequent to a reference time
translation_zh: adv. 然后, 后来
example: We went to the cinema and afterwards we had dinner.

meaning: n. a temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to; n. a list of matters to be taken up (as at a meeting)
translation_zh: pl. 议程, 日常工作事项；[计] 待议事件
example: What's on the agenda for today's meeting?

meaning: n. an active and efficient cause; capable of producing a certain effect; n. a representative who acts on behalf of other persons or organizations; n. a substance that exerts some force or effect; n. a businessman who buys or sells for another in exchange for a commission
translation_zh: n. 代理商, 政府代表, 动原, 媒介；[计] 代理程序
example: She works as a real estate agent.

meaning: a. having or showing determination and energetic pursuit of your ends; positive in his convictions"; s. tending to spread quickly; s. characteristic of an enemy or one eager to fight
translation_zh: a. 侵略的, 挑畔的, 进取的；[法] 侵略的, 爱挑衅的, 行为过火的
example: The dog's aggressive behavior worried its owner.

meaning: n. the statement (oral or written) of an exchange of promises; n. compatibility of observations; n. harmony of people's opinions or actions or characters; n. the thing arranged or agreed to
translation_zh: n. 同意, 合约, 协议；[经] 契约, 协议, 协定
example: We reached an agreement on the terms.

meaning: a. relating to or used in or promoting agriculture or farming
translation_zh: a. 农业的；[法] 农业的, 耕作的
example: The world's supply of agricultural land is shrinking fast.

meaning: n. the class of people engaged in growing food
translation_zh: n. 农业；[机] 农业, 农学
example: The number of people employed in agriculture has fallen in the last decade.

meaning: n. a resource; n. the activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose; n. money to support a worthy person or cause
translation_zh: n. 帮助, 外援, 助手；vt. 援助, 帮助, 有助于；vi. 帮助；[计] 自动内部诊断
example: The country sent humanitarian aid to the disaster zone.

meaning: n. the goal intended to be attained (and which is believed to be attainable); n. the action of directing something at an object; v. point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards; v. propose or intend
translation_zh: n. 目标, 瞄准, 击中目标的能力；vi. 对准目标, 致力, 打算；vt. 瞄准；[计] 医学文摘索引, 存取隔离机构, 高级信息管理程序, 先进接口模块；应用接口模块, 医学人工智能, 相联索引法, 异步接口模块；自动化信息管理, 自动化综合制造, 自动化库存管理
example: He aimed the camera at the bird.

meaning: air conditioning
translation_zh: 用空调设备调节空气, 空调设备；[计] 空调; 空气调节
example: I wish my car had air conditioning.

meaning: air force
translation_zh: 空军, 美国航空队
example: The air force was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a hose that carries air under pressure; n. a commercial enterprise that provides scheduled flights for passengers
translation_zh: n. 航线, 航线的设备, 航空公司
example: He needed to buy an airline ticket immediately.

meaning: n. a liquor or brew containing alcohol as the active agent; n. any of a series of volatile hydroxyl compounds that are made from hydrocarbons by distillation
translation_zh: n. 酒精, 酒；[化] 醇; 乙醇; 酒精
example: Please don't drink alcohol if you are driving.

meaning: n. a person who drinks alcohol to excess habitually; a. characteristic of or containing alcohol; s. addicted to alcohol
translation_zh: n. 酒鬼, 酒精中毒者；a. 酒精的
example: The drink was non-alcoholic, suitable for everyone.

meaning: a. having the same or similar characteristics; r. equally; r. in a like manner
translation_zh: a. 相似的, 同样的；adv. 一样, 以同样的方式
example: The two sisters look very much alike.

meaning: a. characterized by or caused by allergy; s. having an allergy or peculiar or excessive susceptibility (especially to a specific factor)
translation_zh: a. 对...过敏的, 极反感的；[医] 变应性的
example: I am allergic to peanuts.

meaning: v. let have; v. give or assign a resource to a particular person or cause; v. allow or plan for a certain possibility; concede the truth or validity of something; v. grant as a discount or in exchange
translation_zh: vt. 允许, 同意给予, 承认；vi. 容许, 猜想；[计] 允许命令
example: My parents allow me to stay out late.

meaning: n. an amount allowed or granted (as during a given period); n. a sum granted as reimbursement for expenses; n. an amount added or deducted on the basis of qualifying circumstances; n. a permissible difference; allowing some freedom to move within limits
translation_zh: n. 津贴, 零用钱, 限额, 折扣, 允许；vt. 定量供应
example: My parents gave me a weekly allowance.

meaning: r. using the voice; not silently
translation_zh: adv. 出声地, 大声地
example: She spoke aloud during the meeting.

meaning: n. a character set that includes letters and is used to write a language
translation_zh: n. 字母；[计] 字母表
example: Alpha is the first letter of the Greek alphabet.

meaning: r. with everything included or counted
translation_zh: adv. 完全地, 总而言之
example: It was an altogether different experience than I expected.

meaning: s. filled with the emotional impact of overwhelming surprise or shock
translation_zh: a. 吃惊的, 惊奇的
example: This is a very amazed situation.

meaning: a. having a strong desire for success or achievement; s. requiring full use of your abilities or resources
translation_zh: a. 有野心的, 抱负不凡的, 雄心勃勃的
example: They were very ambitious for their children (= they wanted them to be successful).

meaning: n. a vehicle that takes people to and from hospitals
translation_zh: n. 救护车；[医] 救护车
example: The ambulance crew rushed her to the hospital.

meaning: s. providing enjoyment; pleasantly entertaining; s. arousing or provoking laughter
translation_zh: a. 有趣的, 引人发笑的
example: She writes very amusing letters.

meaning: v consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning; v break down into components or essential features; v make a mathematical, chemical, or grammatical analysis of; break down into components or essential features; v subject to psychoanalytic treatment
translation_zh: vt. 分析, 细察, 分解；[经] 分析
example: We need to analyse the data carefully.

meaning: v. consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning; v. make a mathematical, chemical, or grammatical analysis of; break down into components or essential features; v. break down into components or essential features
translation_zh: vt. 分析, 细察, 分解；[机] 分析
example: We need to analyze the data carefully.

meaning: n. a very old person; n. a person who lived in ancient times; s. belonging to times long past especially of the historical period before the fall of the Western Roman Empire; s. very old
translation_zh: a. 古代的, 古老的, 年老的, 旧的
example: We visited an ancient castle.

meaning: n. a strong emotion; a feeling that is oriented toward some real or supposed grievance; n. the state of being angry; v. make angry; v. become angry
translation_zh: n. 忿怒；vt. 激怒, 使发怒；vi. 发怒
example: He couldn't control his anger after the argument.

meaning: n. the space between two lines or planes that intersect; the inclination of one line to another; measured in degrees or radians; n. a member of a Germanic people who conquered England and merged with the Saxons and Jutes to become Anglo-Saxons; v. move or proceed at an angle; v. fish with a hook
translation_zh: n. 角, 角度, 角落；vi. 钓鱼, 谋取, 博取, 斜向移动, 转变角度；vt. 使转动角度, 在...钓鱼, 获取
example: The angle of the roof was steep.

meaning: a. having life or vigor or spirit; s. made to appear to move as living creatures do
translation_zh: a. 活生生的, 能活动的, 活泼的, 欢快的
example: Her face suddenly became animated.

meaning: n. the condition of living or the state of being alive; n. the property of being able to survive and grow; n. quality of being active or spirited or alive and vigorous
translation_zh: n. 活泼, 生气, 激励, 卡通制作；[计] 动画
example: The animation in the movie was amazing.

meaning: n. the date on which an event occurred in some previous year (or the celebration of it)
translation_zh: n. 周年纪念
example: We celebrated our tenth wedding anniversary.

meaning: v. make known; make an announcement; v. announce publicly or officially; v. give the names of; v. foreshadow or presage
translation_zh: vt. 宣布, 声称, 显示, 预告；vi. 当报幕员, 宣布参加竞选
example: They will announce the winner tomorrow.

meaning: n. a formal public statement; n. a public statement containing information about an event that has happened or is going to happen
translation_zh: n. 公告, 发表, 告知；[经] 通告, 布告, 公告
example: The principal made an important announcement.

meaning: n. anger produced by some annoying irritation; n. something or someone that causes trouble; a source of unhappiness; n. the act of troubling or annoying someone
translation_zh: n. 烦恼, 打扰, 可厌之事；[法] 使人烦恼的事物, 麻烦事, 讨厌物
example: The constant noise was a great annoyance.

meaning: s. aroused to impatience or anger; s. troubled persistently especially with petty annoyances
translation_zh: a. 恼怒的；烦闷的
example: This is a very annoyed situation.

meaning: r. without missing a year
translation_zh: adv. 一年一次, 每年；[经] 年度的, 每年的
example: The company publishes its financial report annually.

meaning: n. social insect living in organized colonies; characteristically the males and fertile queen have wings during breeding season; wingless sterile females are the workers
translation_zh: n. 蚂蚁
example: The ant was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a word that expresses a meaning opposed to the meaning of another word, in which case the two words are antonyms of each other
translation_zh: n. 反义词
example: "Old" has two possible antonyms: "young" and "new".

meaning: n. (psychiatry) a relatively permanent state of worry and nervousness occurring in a variety of mental disorders, usually accompanied by compulsive behavior or attacks of panic; n. a vague unpleasant emotion that is experienced in anticipation of some (usually ill-defined) misfortune
translation_zh: n. 焦虑, 忧虑, 令人焦虑的事；[医] 焦虑
example: Some hospital patients experience high levels of anxiety.

meaning: r. with anxiety or apprehension
translation_zh: adv. 忧虑地, 不安地
example: She spoke anxiously during the meeting.

meaning: r. used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement; anyhow, they're quiet"; anyway, it's gone"; in any case, there was a brief scuffle"; r. in any way whatsoever
translation_zh: adv. 无论如何, 至少
example: It started to rain, but we went out anyhow.

meaning: r. at the present or from now on; usually used with a negative
translation_zh: adv. 再也不, 不再
example: I don't live there anymore.

meaning: r used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement; anyhow, they're quiet"; anyway, it's gone"; in any case, there was a brief scuffle"; r in any way whatsoever
translation_zh: adv. 无论如何, 至少
example: It was raining, but we went out anyway.

meaning: n. any of various primates with short tails or no tail at all; v. imitate uncritically and in every aspect
translation_zh: n. 无尾猿；[计] 应用程序评价
example: Chimpanzees are a type of ape.

meaning: n. an expression of regret at having caused trouble for someone; n. a formal written defense of something you believe in strongly; n. a poor example
translation_zh: n. 道歉, 辩护；[法] 道歉, 谢罪, 辩解者
example: You owe him an apology for what you said.

meaning: application
translation_zh: [计] 应用, 应用程序; 相联并行处理器
example: I downloaded a new app on my phone.

meaning: s. clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment; s. appearing as such but not necessarily so
translation_zh: a. 清晰可见的, 显然的, 表面上的；[电] 外在的
example: Their devotion was apparent.

meaning: n. outward or visible aspect of a person or thing; n. the event of coming into sight; n. formal attendance (in court or at a hearing) of a party in an action; n. a mental representation
translation_zh: n. 出现, 露面, 外观, 外表, 出版；[计] 外观, 版面
example: Her sudden appearance surprised everyone.

meaning: n. a feeling of craving something
translation_zh: n. 食欲, 欲望, 爱好；[医] 食欲
example: Exercise can increase your appetite.

meaning: v. clap one's hands or shout after performances to indicate approval; v. express approval of
translation_zh: v. 拍手喝彩, 称赞, 赞同
example: We need to applaud this carefully.

meaning: n. a demonstration of approval by clapping the hands together
translation_zh: n. 鼓掌, 喝彩, 赞许
example: The audience erupted in thunderous applause.

meaning: n. the act of bringing something to bear; using it for a particular purpose; n. a verbal or written request for assistance or employment or admission to a school; n. the work of applying something;; n. a program that gives a computer instructions that provide the user with tools to accomplish a task
translation_zh: n. 应用, 申请, 志愿书, 应用程序；[计] 应用, 应用程序
example: You need to fill out an application for the job.

meaning: v. create and charge with a task or function; v. assign a duty, responsibility or obligation to; v. furnish
translation_zh: vt. 任命, 指定, 下令；[法] 派, 派任, 任命
example: They decided to appoint her as the new manager.

meaning: v. recognize with gratitude; be grateful for; v. be fully aware of; realize fully; v. gain in value; v. increase the value of
translation_zh: vt. 赏识, 鉴别, 为...而感激, 领会, 欣赏；vi. 增值, 涨价
example: I really appreciate your help.

meaning: n. understanding of the nature or meaning or quality or magnitude of something; n. an expression of gratitude; n. an increase in price or value
translation_zh: n. 感激, 赏识, 鉴别；[经] 涨价, 增值
example: We showed our appreciation for their hard work.

meaning: n. ideas or actions intended to deal with a problem or situation; n. the act of drawing spatially closer to something; n. the event of one object coming closer to another; n. the temporal property of becoming nearer in time
translation_zh: n. 接近, 入门；vt. 接近, 近似, 找...商量；vi. 靠近
example: We need a new approach to solve this problem.

meaning: v. give sanction to; v. judge to be right or commendable; think well of
translation_zh: vt. 赞同, 核准, 为...提供证据；vi. 赞许
example: The committee needs to approve the new plan.

meaning: n. someone who creates plans to be used in making something (such as buildings)
translation_zh: n. 建筑师, 设计者, 缔造者
example: The architect presented the plans for the new library.

meaning: n. a fact or assertion offered as evidence that something is true; n. a discussion in which reasons are advanced for and against some proposition or proposal; n. a summary of the subject or plot of a literary work or play or movie; n. (computer science) a reference or value that is passed to a function, procedure, subroutine, command, or program
translation_zh: n. 争论, 论证, 论据, 自变量；[计] 参数
example: They had a long argument about politics.

meaning: v. originate or come into being; v. rise to one's feet; v. result or issue
translation_zh: vi. 站立, 出现, 起来
example: We need to arise this carefully.

meaning: n. the branch of pure mathematics dealing with the theory of numerical calculations
translation_zh: n. 算术, 算术知识；[机] 算术; 算术的
example: Basic arithmetic skills are essential for everyday life.

meaning: n. a human limb; technically the part of the superior limb between the shoulder and the elbow but commonly used to refer to the whole superior limb; n. any projection that is thought to resemble a human arm; n. the part of an armchair or sofa that supports the elbow and forearm of a seated person; v. prepare oneself for a military confrontation
translation_zh: n. 手臂, 袖子, 狭长港湾, 武器；vt. 武装, 装备；vi. 武装起来；[计] ARM 处理器；异步应答方式; 自动货品销路管理
example: He broke his arm.

meaning: n. a permanent organization of the military land forces of a nation or state; n. a large number of people united for some specific purpose
translation_zh: n. 军队, 陆军
example: The army was deployed to help with disaster relief.

meaning: v. put into a proper or systematic order; v. make arrangements for; v. adapt for performance in a different way; v. arrange thoughts, ideas, temporal events
translation_zh: v. 安排, 排列, 达成协议；[计] 重排
example: We need to arrange this carefully.

meaning: n. an orderly grouping (of things or persons) considered as a unit; the result of arranging; n. an organized structure for arranging or classifying; n. the act of arranging and adapting a piece of music
translation_zh: n. 排列, 整齐, 安排；[计] 排列
example: We need to make an arrangement for the meeting next week.

meaning: n. the state of inactivity following an interruption
translation_zh: n. 逮捕, 监禁；vt. 拘捕, 抑制, 吸引, 阻止
example: The police decided to arrest the suspect.

meaning: n. accomplishment of an objective; n. the act of arriving at a certain place; n. someone who arrives (or has arrived)
translation_zh: n. 到达, 抵达, 到达者；[经] 到达, 到达物
example: We waited for their arrival at the airport.

meaning: n. a mark to indicate a direction or relation; n. a projectile with a straight thin shaft and an arrowhead on one end and stabilizing vanes on the other; intended to be shot from a bow
translation_zh: n. 箭, 箭状物, 箭头记号
example: The road continues as straight as an arrow.

meaning: a. relating to or characteristic of art or artists; s. satisfying aesthetic standards and sensibilities
translation_zh: a. 艺术的, 艺术家的, 富有艺术性的
example: She has a very artistic talent.

meaning: a. feeling shame or guilt or embarrassment or remorse
translation_zh: a. 惭愧的, 羞耻的
example: She felt ashamed of her behavior.

meaning: n. a native or inhabitant of Asia; a. of or relating to or characteristic of Asia or the peoples of Asia or their languages or culture
translation_zh: n. 亚洲人；a. 亚洲的, 亚洲人的
example: She enjoys Asian cuisine.

meaning: n. a line spoken by an actor to the audience but not intended for others on the stage; r. on or to one side; r. out of the way (especially away from one's thoughts); r. placed or kept separate and distinct as for a purpose
translation_zh: n. 小声说的话, 旁白；adv. 在一边, 离开, 另外
example: She spoke aside during the meeting.

meaning: n. the acetylated derivative of salicylic acid; used as an analgesic anti-inflammatory drug (trade names Bayer, Empirin, and St. Joseph) usually taken in tablet form; used as an antipyretic; slows clotting of the blood by poisoning platelets
translation_zh: n. 阿斯匹林；[化] 乙酰水杨酸; 阿司匹灵; 邻乙酸基苯甲酸
example: I took an aspirin for my headache.

meaning: v. give out; v. select something or someone for a specific purpose; v. transfer one's right to; v. decide as to where something belongs in a scheme
translation_zh: vt. 分配, 指派, 赋值；[计] 赋值
example: The teacher assigned homework to the students.

meaning: n. a duty that you are assigned to perform (especially in the armed forces); n. the instrument by which a claim or right or interest or property is transferred from one person to another; n. the act of distributing something to designated places or persons; n. an undertaking that you have been assigned to do (as by an instructor)
translation_zh: n. 分配, 功课, 任务, 转让, 归因, 陈述；[计] 赋值
example: I have a lot of homework assignments this week.

meaning: n. (sports) the act of enabling another player to make a good play; v. act as an assistant in a subordinate or supportive function
translation_zh: n. 帮助, 协助；vt. 帮助, 促进；vi. 协助, 参加
example: Can I assist you with your bags?

meaning: n the activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose; n a resource
translation_zh: n. 协助, 援助；[经] 援助, 帮助
example: Thank you for your assistance.

meaning: n. a physicist who studies astronomy
translation_zh: n. 天文学家
example: The astronomer discovered a new galaxy.

meaning: a. relating to or befitting athletics or athletes; s. having a sturdy and well proportioned body
translation_zh: a. 运动的
example: He has a very athletic build.

meaning: n. the 2nd largest ocean; separates North and South America on the west from Europe and Africa on the east; a. relating to or bordering the Atlantic Ocean
translation_zh: n. 大西洋；a. 大西洋的
example: This is a very atlantic situation.

meaning: n. a particular environment or surrounding influence; n. the mass of air surrounding the Earth; n. the weather or climate at some place; n. the envelope of gases surrounding any celestial body
translation_zh: n. 大气, 空气, 气氛；[医] 大气; 大气压
example: The restaurant had a very relaxed atmosphere.

meaning: a. of or relating to or comprising atoms; s. immeasurably small
translation_zh: a. 原子的, 原子能的；[医] 原子的
example: This is a very atomic situation.

meaning: v. cause to be attached; v. be attached; be in contact with; v. become attached
translation_zh: vt. 附上, 使依附, 使附属, 使喜爱, 系, 缚；vi. 附属, 归属, 联系在一起；[计] 挂接服务器命令, 关联, 挂接, 附加
example: Please attach your resume to the application form.

meaning: n. a feeling of affection for a person or an institution; n. a supplementary part or accessory; n. a writ authorizing the seizure of property that may be needed for the payment of a judgment in a judicial proceeding
translation_zh: n. 连接, 附属物, 连接物, 爱慕；[计] 附加, 附件
example: No attachment was included.

meaning: n. (military) an offensive against an enemy (using weapons); n. an offensive move in a sport or game; n. the act of attacking; n. a decisive manner of beginning a musical tone or phrase
translation_zh: n. 攻击, 抨击；vt. 攻击, 抨击, 动手干；vi. 攻击
example: The city was under attack.

meaning: v to gain with effort; v reach a point in time, or a certain state or level; v find unexpectedly; v reach a destination, either real or abstract
translation_zh: vt. 达到, 获得；vi. 达到
example: We need to attain this carefully.

meaning: n. earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something
translation_zh: n. 尝试, 企图；vt. 尝试, 企图
example: This is my first attempt at baking a cake.

meaning: n. the process whereby a person concentrates on some features of the environment to the (relative) exclusion of others; n. a general interest that leads people to want to know more; n. a courteous act indicating affection; n. the faculty or power of mental concentration
translation_zh: n. 注意, 注意力；[计] 引起注意信号
example: Please pay attention in class.

meaning: n. a complex mental state involving beliefs and feelings and values and dispositions to act in certain ways; n. a theatrical pose created for effect; n. position of aircraft or spacecraft relative to a frame of reference (the horizon or direction of motion)
translation_zh: n. 态度, 看法, 姿势；[医] 体态, 姿势, 态度
example: She has a very positive attitude towards life.

meaning: v. direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological power or physical attributes; v. be attractive to; v. exert a force on (a body) causing it to approach or prevent it from moving away
translation_zh: vt. 吸引, 诱惑；vi. 有吸引力
example: The bright colors attract butterflies.

meaning: n. the force by which one object attracts another; n. an entertainment that is offered to the public; n. the quality of arousing interest; being attractive or something that attracts; n. a characteristic that provides pleasure and attracts
translation_zh: n. 吸引, 吸引人的事物, 吸引力；[医] 吸引
example: The Eiffel Tower is a major tourist attraction in Paris.

meaning: n. a gathering of spectators or listeners at a (usually public) performance; n. the part of the general public interested in a source of information or entertainment
translation_zh: n. 听众, 观众, 读者；[法] 听讼, 观众, 听众
example: The audience applauded loudly after the show.

meaning: n. the audible part of a transmitted signal; n. an audible acoustic wave frequency; n. the sound elements of television
translation_zh: a. 音频的, 声音的；[电] 声频
example: The audio quality of the recording was excellent.

meaning: v. be the author of
translation_zh: n. 作家, 作家的著作, 创始人；[法] 作者, 著作人, 本人
example: Who is the author of this book?

meaning: n. the power or right to give orders or make decisions; n. (usually plural) persons who exercise (administrative) control over others; n. an expert whose views are taken as definitive; n. official permission or approval
translation_zh: n. 权力, 当权者, 当局, 权威, 专家；[经] 代理权, 授权, 权威
example: The police have the authority to stop vehicles.

meaning: n a motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine
translation_zh: n. 汽车；pref. 表示"自己"、"本身", 表示"自己的", 表示"自动的"
example: He bought a new auto last month.

meaning: r. in a reflex manner
translation_zh: adv. 自动地, 机械地
example: The door opens automatically when you approach it.

meaning: s. functioning in a supporting capacity
translation_zh: n. 辅助者, 辅助物, 附属机构, 助动词；a. 辅助的, 备用的
example: In the sentence "she has finished her book," "has" is an auxiliary.

meaning: a. obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service; s. not busy; not otherwise committed; s. convenient for use or disposal
translation_zh: a. 可利用的, 可获得的, 有效的；[医] 有效的, 可得的
example: The book is available in the library.

meaning: n. a line of approach; n. a wide street or thoroughfare
translation_zh: n. 大街, 途径, 林荫路
example: They live on a tree-lined avenue.

meaning: n. a statistic describing the location of a distribution; n. (sports) the ratio of successful performances to opportunities; n. an intermediate scale value regarded as normal or usual; v. amount to or come to an average, without loss or gain
translation_zh: n. 平均, 平均数, 一般水平, 海损；a. 平均的, 中等的, 平常的；vt. 算出...平均数, 平均做, 均分, 使平衡；vi. 平均为, 呈中间色
example: The average temperature today is 20 degrees Celsius.

meaning: v. stay clear from; keep away from; keep out of the way of someone or something; v. refrain from doing something
translation_zh: vt. 避免, 防止, 撤消；[法] 避免, 回避, 躲开
example: Try to avoid making the same mistake twice.

meaning: n. a grant made by a law court; n. a tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction; v. give, especially as an honor or reward; v. give as judged due or on the basis of merit
translation_zh: n. 奖品, 裁定, 判决；vt. 授予, 给予
example: She won an award for her research.

meaning: a. (sometimes followed by `of') having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception
translation_zh: a. 知道的, 有觉悟的
example: Are you aware of the risks?

meaning: n. having knowledge of; n. state of elementary or undifferentiated consciousness
translation_zh: n. 意识, 认识；[计] 识别, 议定, 明白
example: There was an almost complete lack of awareness of the issues involved.

meaning: s inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
translation_zh: a. 引起敬畏的, 可怕的
example: That concert was awesome!

meaning: s. causing inconvenience; a. lacking grace or skill in manner or movement or performance; s. difficult to handle or manage especially because of shape; s. not elegant or graceful in expression
translation_zh: a. 笨拙的, 棘手的
example: There was an awkward silence after his comment.

meaning: babysit
translation_zh: vi. (代人临时)照看婴孩
example: We need to babysit this carefully.

meaning: n. a person engaged to care for children when the parents are not home
translation_zh: n. 临时照顾幼儿者
example: The babysitter was important for everyone.

meaning: n. an ache localized in the back
translation_zh: n. 背痛
example: The backache was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a person's social heritage: previous experience or training; n. the part of a scene (or picture) that lies behind objects in the foreground; n. information that is essential to understanding a situation or problem; n. extraneous signals that can be confused with the phenomenon to be observed or measured
translation_zh: n. 背景, 背景资料；[计] 背景, 后台
example: He has a strong background in computer science.

meaning: n. a bag carried by a strap on your back or shoulder; v. hike with a backpack
translation_zh: n. 远足用的背包；双肩背包, 背包
example: The backpack was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a hiker who wears a backpack
translation_zh: n. 背包旅行者
example: Many young backpackers travel through Southeast Asia.

meaning: n carrying something in a pack on the back; v hike with a backpack
translation_zh: n. 徒步旅行
example: The backpacking was important for everyone.

meaning: n. back and sides of a hog salted and dried or smoked; usually sliced thin and fried; n. English scientist and Franciscan monk who stressed the importance of experimentation; first showed that air is required for combustion and first used lenses to correct vision (1220-1292); n. English statesman and philosopher; precursor of British empiricism; advocated inductive reasoning (1561-1626)
translation_zh: n. 熏猪肉；[机] 腌肉
example: His friends had all gone to college or were bringing home the bacon.

meaning: n. cases used to carry belongings when traveling; n. a worthless or immoral woman; n. the portable equipment and supplies of an army
translation_zh: n. 行李；[经] 行李
example: We loaded our baggage into the car.

meaning: n. someone who bakes commercially; n. someone who bakes bread or cake
translation_zh: n. 面包师；[医] 烤箱(骨科用)
example: The baker was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a workplace where baked goods (breads and cakes and pastries) are produced or sold
translation_zh: n. 面包店
example: The bakery was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a state of equilibrium; n. equality between the totals of the credit and debit sides of an account; n. equality of distribution; n. the difference between the totals of the credit and debit sides of an account
translation_zh: n. 平衡, 差额；vi. 平衡, 相等；vt. 称, 权衡, 比较, 使平衡, 结算, 抵消
example: He lost his balance and fell.

meaning: v. grow bald; lose hair on one's head; s. with no effort to conceal; s. lacking hair on all or most of the scalp; s. without the natural or usual covering
translation_zh: a. 秃头的, 光秃的, 单调的, 赤裸的；vi. 变秃
example: My uncle started to go bald in his thirties.

meaning: n. 100 bani equal 1 leu in Moldova; n. 100 bani equal 1 leu in Romania; n. an official prohibition or edict against something; v. forbid the public distribution of ( a movie or a newspaper)
translation_zh: n. 禁令；vt. 禁止, 取缔
example: Smoking is banned in all public buildings.

meaning: n. a piece of soft material that covers and protects an injured part of the body; v. dress by covering or binding
translation_zh: n. 绷带；[化] 帘布筒; 实心轮胎; 紧带; 绷带
example: You ought to bandage (up) that cut.

meaning: n. a sudden very loud noise; n. a border of hair that is cut short and hangs across the forehead; n. the swift release of a store of affective force; v. to produce a sharp often metallic explosive or percussive sound
translation_zh: n. 重击, 突然巨响, 刘海；v. 发巨响, 重击；adv. 砰然地, 突然巨响地, 直接地；[计] 撞击符
example: We heard a loud bang from the kitchen.

meaning: bank account
translation_zh: 银行存款；银行往来帐户
example: The bank account was important for everyone.

meaning: v. lay bare; s. completely unclothed; s. lacking in amplitude or quantity; a. lacking its natural or customary covering
translation_zh: a. 赤裸的, 缺少的, 无遮蔽的, 坦率的；vt. 使赤裸, 露出
example: He walked across the bare floor.

meaning: r. only a very short time before
translation_zh: adv. 几乎不
example: She could barely hear him over the noise.

meaning: n. tough protective covering of the woody stems and roots of trees and other woody plants; n. a noise resembling the bark of a dog; n. a sailing ship with 3 (or more) masts; n. the sound made by a dog
translation_zh: n. 树皮, 吠声；vi. 吠, 叫骂；vt. 喊出, 剥树皮
example: The dog's loud bark startled the cat.

meaning: n an employee who mixes and serves alcoholic drinks at a bar
translation_zh: n. 酒吧间男招待
example: The barman quickly mixed our cocktails.

meaning: n. a tube through which a bullet travels when a gun is fired; n. a cylindrical container that holds liquids; n. a bulging cylindrical shape; hollow with flat ends; n. the quantity that a barrel (of any size) will hold
translation_zh: n. 桶；vt. 装入桶内
example: They stored water in a large wooden barrel.

meaning: n. installation from which a military force initiates operations; n. a place that the runner must touch before scoring; n. the bottom or lowest part; n. (anatomy) the part of an organ nearest its point of attachment
translation_zh: n. 底部, 垒, 基础, 基地；vt. 以...作基础；a. 卑鄙的, 低劣的；[计] 基准
example: The movie is based on a true story.

meaning: n. the lowermost portion of a structure partly or wholly below ground level; often used for storage; n. the ground floor facade or interior in Renaissance architecture
translation_zh: n. 地下室, 墙脚；[化] 地下室
example: Kitchen goods are sold in the basement.

meaning: r. in essence; at bottom or by one's (or its) very nature
translation_zh: adv. 基本上, 主要地
example: Basically, the plan is to save money.

meaning: n. a bowl-shaped vessel; usually used for holding food or liquids; n. the quantity that a basin will hold; n. a natural depression in the surface of the land often with a lake at the bottom of it
translation_zh: n. 盆, 盆地；[医] 第三脑室, 骨盆
example: She washed her hands in the basin.

meaning: n. nocturnal mouselike mammal with forelimbs modified to form membranous wings and anatomical adaptations for echolocation by which they navigate; n. (baseball) a turn trying to get a hit; n. a club used for hitting a ball in various games; v. strike with, or as if with a baseball bat
translation_zh: n. 蝙蝠, 球棒；v. 用球棒打, 眨眼；[计] 成批
example: It's his first time at bat in the major leagues.

meaning: n. the act of swimming; v. cleanse the entire body; v. suffuse with or as if with light; v. clean one's body by immersion into water
translation_zh: vt. 沐浴, 用水洗；vi. 洗澡
example: We need to bathe this carefully.

meaning: n. an indentation of a shoreline larger than a cove but smaller than a gulf; n. the sound of a hound on the scent; n. a compartment on a ship between decks; often used as a hospital; n. a compartment in an aircraft used for some specific purpose
translation_zh: n. 海湾, 狗吠声, 月桂；vt. 吠, 使走投无路；vi. 吠
example: We sailed into a beautiful bay.

meaning: n. massive plantigrade carnivorous or omnivorous mammals with long shaggy coats and strong claws; n. an investor with a pessimistic market outlook; an investor who expects prices to fall and so sells now in order to buy later at a lower price; v. have; v. move while holding up or supporting
translation_zh: n. 熊；vt. 忍受, 支承, 产生, 怀有, 通过卖空使跌价；vi. 忍受, 结果实, 压挤, 行进, 转向
example: I can't bear the thought of losing you.

meaning: n. the hair growing on the lower part of a man's face; n. a tuft or growth of hairs or bristles on certain plants such as iris or grasses; n. a person who diverts suspicion from someone (especially a woman who accompanies a male homosexual in order to conceal his homosexuality); n. hairy growth on or near the face of certain mammals
translation_zh: n. 胡须；vt. 抓住胡须, 公开反对
example: He has decided to grow a beard and a moustache.

meaning: n. a cruelly rapacious person
translation_zh: n. 畜生, 动物, 野兽, 兽性
example: The beast emerged from the forest.

meaning: r. in a beautiful manner
translation_zh: adv. 美好地, 漂亮地
example: She spoke beautifully during the meeting.

meaning: n. the soft brown fur of the beaver; n. a full beard; n. a movable piece of armor on a medieval helmet used to protect the lower face; n. a hat made with the fur of a beaver (or similar material)
translation_zh: n. 海狸(毛皮)；[机] 轻型及中型飞机加油
example: The beaver was important for everyone.

meaning: because of
translation_zh: 因为
example: The because of was important for everyone.

meaning: n. space by the side of a bed (especially the bed of a sick or dying person)
translation_zh: n. 床边；a. 床边的, 临床的
example: She kept a glass of water on her bedside table.

meaning: n. as the agent of or on someone's part (usually expressed as "on behalf of" rather than "in behalf of");; n. for someone's benefit (usually expressed as `in behalf' rather than `on behalf' and usually with a possessive)
translation_zh: n. 利益, 方面
example: He began a petition in behalf of the farmers.

meaning: v. behave in a certain manner; v. behave well or properly
translation_zh: vi. 举止端正, 行为规矩；vt. 检点(自己的)行为, 使表现好
example: We need to behave this carefully.

meaning: n. manner of acting or controlling yourself; n. the action or reaction of something (as a machine or substance) under specified circumstances; n. (psychology) the aggregate of the responses or reactions or movements made by an organism in any situation
translation_zh: n. 行为, 举止；[医] 行为
example: His behavior in class was excellent.

meaning: n. any cognitive content held as true
translation_zh: n. 信念, 相信, 信仰
example: He has a strong belief in justice.

meaning: n. a beloved person; used as terms of endearment; s. dearly loved
translation_zh: a. 心爱的；n. 心爱的人
example: They were glad to be back in their beloved Ireland.

meaning: r in or to a place that is lower
translation_zh: prep. 在...下方；adv. 在...下方
example: They found the body buried beneath a pile of leaves.

meaning: n. financial assistance in time of need; n. something that aids or promotes well-being; n. a performance to raise money for a charitable cause; v. be beneficial for
translation_zh: n. 利益；vt. 有益于；vi. 受益
example: There are many benefits to exercising regularly.

meaning: n. a relatively permanent inclination to react in a particular way; n. grass for pastures and lawns especially bowling and putting greens; n. an area of grassland unbounded by fences or hedges; n. a special way of doing something
translation_zh: a. 弯曲的, 决心的；n. 爱好；bend的过去式和过去分词
example: This is a very bent situation.

meaning: n. the act of gambling; v. maintain with or as if with a bet; v. stake on the outcome of an issue
translation_zh: n. 打赌, 赌注；v. 打赌
example: I wouldn't bet on that horse.

meaning: n. a person who speaks two languages fluently; s. using or knowing two languages
translation_zh: a. 双语的
example: She is bilingual in English and Spanish.

meaning: n. the number that is represented as a one followed by 12 zeros; in the United Kingdom the usage followed in the United States is frequently seen; n. the number that is represented as a one followed by 9 zeros; s. denoting a quantity consisting of one thousand million items or units in the United States; s. denoting a quantity consisting of one million million items or units in Great Britain
translation_zh: num. 十亿, 十亿个
example: The world population is over seven billion people.

meaning: n. a container; usually has a lid; n. the quantity contained in a bin; v. store in bins
translation_zh: n. (贮存谷物等的)容器, 箱子；[计] 二进制, 商业信息网
example: Grey bins will be emptied weekly.

meaning: n. the organic chemistry of compounds and processes occurring in organisms; the effort to understand biology within the context of chemistry
translation_zh: n. 生物化学；[化] 生物化学; 生化
example: Your biochemistry is almost identical to that of your cat.

meaning: n. an account of the series of events making up a person's life
translation_zh: n. 传记
example: I read a fascinating biography of Marie Curie.

meaning: n. the science that studies living organisms; n. characteristic life processes and phenomena of living organisms
translation_zh: n. 生物学；[化] 生物; 生物学
example: She is studying biology at university.

meaning: n. a senior member of the Christian clergy having spiritual and administrative authority; appointed in Christian churches to oversee priests or ministers; considered in some churches to be successors of the twelve Apostles of Christ; n. port wine mulled with oranges and cloves; n. (chess) a piece that can be moved diagonally over unoccupied squares of the same color
translation_zh: n. 主教, (国际象棋中的)象, 热果子酒
example: He was appointed Bishop of Ely.

meaning: n. English term for a dry sharp-tasting ale with strong flavor of hops (usually on draft); n. the taste experience when quinine or coffee is taken into the mouth; v. make bitter; s. very difficult to accept or bear
translation_zh: a. 苦的, 痛苦的, 怀恨的；adv. 刺骨；v. (使)变苦
example: The coffee was very bitter without sugar.

meaning: n. a reproach for some lapse or misdeed; v. put or pin the blame on; v. harass with constant criticism; v. attribute responsibility to
translation_zh: n. 过失, 责备；vt. 责备, 归咎于
example: Don't put all the blame on yourself.

meaning: v. draw blood; v. get or extort (money or other possessions) from someone; v. drain of liquid or steam
translation_zh: vi. 流血, 悲痛, 渗出；vt. 使出血, 榨取
example: His nose started to bleed after the fall.

meaning: v. give a benediction to; v. confer prosperity or happiness on; v. make the sign of the cross over someone in order to call on God for protection; consecrate
translation_zh: vt. 祝福, 祈佑, 使神圣化
example: May God bless you and your family.

meaning: n. the formal act of approving; n. a desirable state; n. the act of praying for divine protection
translation_zh: n. 祝福
example: Her recovery was a true blessing.

meaning: n. people who have severe visual impairments, considered as a group; n. a hiding place sometimes used by hunters (especially duck hunters); n. a protective covering that keeps things out or hinders sight; v. render unable to see
translation_zh: n. 蒙蔽物, 窗帘；a. 盲目的, 瞎的, 不加思考的；vt. 使失明, 蒙蔽, 遮暗；adv. 盲目地
example: He has been blind since birth.

meaning: v. read, write, or edit a shared on-line journal
translation_zh: n. 博客；部落格；网络日志
example: She writes a popular blog about travel.

meaning: n. a person who keeps and updates a blog
translation_zh: n. 写博客的人；博客使用者
example: She is a popular fashion blogger.

meaning: n. the fluid (red in vertebrates) that is pumped through the body by the heart and contains plasma, blood cells, and platelets; n. temperament or disposition; n. people viewed as members of a group; v. smear with blood, as in a hunting initiation rite, where the face of a person is smeared with the blood of the kill
translation_zh: n. 血, 血统, 流血, 气质, 生命；vt. 使出血, 用血涂
example: Blood flows through our veins.

meaning: n. sudden reddening of the face (as from embarrassment or guilt or shame or modesty); v. turn red, as if in embarrassment or shame; v. become rosy or reddish
translation_zh: vi. 脸红, 羞愧；vt. 弄成红色；n. 脸红
example: She would always blush when he complimented her.

meaning: n. speaking of yourself in superlatives; v. show off
translation_zh: n. 吹牛；vi. 吹牛, 自夸；vt. 夸口说, 自恃有
example: We need to boast this carefully.

meaning: a. fearless and daring; s. clear and distinct
translation_zh: a. 大胆的；n. 粗体；[计] 粗体
example: It was a bold decision to quit her job and start her own business.

meaning: r. with boldness, in a bold manner
translation_zh: adv. 大胆地, 显眼地
example: She spoke boldly during the meeting.

meaning: n. an explosive device fused to explode under specific conditions
translation_zh: n. 炸弹；vt. 轰炸, 投弹于；vi. 失败
example: The police found an unexploded bomb.

meaning: n. a written work or composition that has been published (printed on pages bound together); n. physical objects consisting of a number of pages bound together; n. a collection of playing cards satisfying the rules of a card game; n. a collection of rules or prescribed standards on the basis of which decisions are made
translation_zh: n. 书, 书籍, 帐簿, 名册, 工作簿；v. 登记, 预订；[计] 工作簿
example: I am reading a good book.

meaning: n. the act of reserving (a place or passage) or engaging the services of (a person or group)
translation_zh: n. 预约演出合同；[机] 书型模法
example: We have a booking for dinner at 7 PM.

meaning: n. a deep prolonged loud noise; n. a state of economic prosperity; n. a sudden happening that brings good fortune (as a sudden opportunity to make money); n. a pole carrying an overhead microphone projected over a film or tv set
translation_zh: n. 繁荣, 隆隆声；vi. 急速发展, 发隆隆声；vt. 使兴旺, 发隆隆声
example: Living standards improved rapidly during the post-war boom.

meaning: n. footwear that covers the whole foot and lower leg; n. British term for the luggage compartment in a car; n. protective casing for something that resembles a leg; n. an instrument of torture that is used to heat or crush the foot and leg
translation_zh: n. 长靴, 踢, 解雇, 效用；vt. 使穿靴, 踢, 解雇, 有用；[计] 引导, 自举
example: She wore black knee-high boots.

meaning: n. a strip forming the outer edge of something; v. provide with a border or edge; v. lie adjacent to another or share a boundary
translation_zh: n. 边缘, 边境, 边界, 花坛；vt. 在...上镶边, 接近；vi. 接界, 近似；[计] 边框
example: We crossed the border into Canada.

meaning: n. a person who evokes boredom; n. diameter of a tube or gun barrel; n. a hole or passage made by a drill; usually made for exploratory purposes; v. cause to be bored
translation_zh: n. 令人讨厌的人, 激浪, 枪膛, 孔；vt. 使烦扰, 钻孔；vi. 钻孔；bear的过去式；[计] 内径; 孔径
example: His long speech began to bore the audience.

meaning: n. the feeling of being bored by something tedious
translation_zh: n. 厌烦, 厌倦, 令人厌烦的事物
example: She suffered from extreme boredom during the long lecture.

meaning: v. intrude or enter uninvited; v. make nervous or agitated; v. make confused or perplexed or puzzled
translation_zh: vt. 烦扰, 迷惑；vi. 烦恼, 操心；n. 麻烦, 纠纷, 讨厌的人
example: Don't bother me when I'm working.

meaning: v. form the boundary of; be contiguous to; a. confined by bonds; a. held with another element, substance or material in chemical or physical union; a. secured with a cover or binding; often used as a combining form
translation_zh: n. 跃, 回跳, 范围, 边界；a. 受约束的, 装有封面的, 有义务的, 关联的, 被束缚的, 准备去...的, 便秘的；vi. 跳跃, 弹起；vt. 使跳, 限制, 形成...的疆界；bind过去式和过去分词；[计] 装订的
example: There are bound to be changes when the new system is introduced.

meaning: n. a knot with two loops and loose ends; used to tie shoelaces; n. a slightly curved piece of resilient wood with taut horsehair strands; used in playing certain stringed instruments; n. front part of a vessel or aircraft; n. a weapon for shooting arrows, composed of a curved piece of resilient wood with a taut cord to propel the arrow
translation_zh: n. 弓, 眼睛框；v. 用弓拉琴, 弯成弓形；n. 鞠躬, 屈服
example: He tied a bow in his shoelaces.

meaning: n. a round vessel that is open at the top; used chiefly for holding food or liquids;; n. a concave shape with an open top; n. a dish that is round and open at the top for serving foods; n. the quantity contained in a bowl
translation_zh: n. 碗, 木球, 大酒杯；v. 滚木球, 快而稳地行驶
example: She filled the bowl with soup.

meaning: n. fighting with the fists
translation_zh: n. 拳击；[医] 围模(牙科)
example: Many doctors believe that boxing is too dangerous and should be banned.

meaning: n. jewelry worn around the wrist for decoration
translation_zh: n. 手镯；[医] 手镯, 腕带, 腕纹(掌侧横列腕部的线纹)
example: The bracelet was important for everyone.

meaning: n. that part of the central nervous system that includes all the higher nervous centers; enclosed within the skull; continuous with the spinal cord; n. mental ability; n. the brain of certain animals used as meat; v. hit on the head
translation_zh: n. 脑；vt. 打碎脑部
example: The human brain is incredibly complex.

meaning: n. a group problem-solving technique in which members spontaneously share ideas and solutions
translation_zh: 自由讨论, 发表独创[创造]性意见, 智力爆发
example: The brainstorming was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a recognizable kind; n. identification mark on skin, made by burning; n. a piece of wood that has been burned or is burning; v. burn with a branding iron to indicate ownership; of animals
translation_zh: n. 商标, 牌子, 烙印；vt. 打烙印于
example: What brand of shoes do you prefer?

meaning: n. conformity or harmony
translation_zh: n. 保管, 供养, 一致；[法] 保管, 保护, 管理
example: 这个遵守为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. conspicuously new
translation_zh: a. 崭新的
example: This is a very brand-new situation.

meaning: n. an alloy of copper and zinc; n. a wind instrument that consists of a brass tube (usually of variable length) that is blown by means of a cup-shaped or funnel-shaped mouthpiece; n. an ornament or utensil made of brass; n. a memorial made of brass
translation_zh: n. 黄铜, 黄铜制品；a. 黄铜的, 铜管乐器的；v. 镀以黄铜, 支付
example: The statue was made of brass.

meaning: r. in a courageous manner
translation_zh: adv. 勇敢地
example: She spoke bravely during the meeting.

meaning: v get something; come into possession of; v receive a specified treatment (abstract); v register (perceptual input); v go through (mental or physical states or experiences); v express willingness to have in one's home or environs; v accept as true or valid; v bid welcome to; greet upon arrival; v convert into sounds or pictures; v experience as a reaction; v have or give a reception; v receive as a retribution or punishment; v partake of the Holy Eucharist sacrament; v regard favorably or with disapproval
translation_zh: [计] 接收
example: 这个接受为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. making an important discovery; n. a penetration of a barrier such as an enemy's defense
translation_zh: n. 突破；[经] 突破, 新发现, 新进展
example: Scientists are hoping for a breakthrough in the search for a cure for cancer.

meaning: n lighter consisting of a thin piece of wood or cardboard tipped with combustible chemical; ignites with friction; n a formal contest in which two or more persons or teams compete; n a burning piece of wood or cardboard; n an exact duplicate; n the score needed to win a match; n a person regarded as a good matrimonial prospect; n a person who is of equal standing with another in a group; n a pair of people who live together; n something that resembles or harmonizes with; v be compatible, similar or consistent; coincide in their characteristics; v provide funds complementary to; v bring two objects, ideas, or people together; v be equal to in quality or ability; v make correspond or harmonize; v satisfy or fulfill; v give or join in marriage; v set into opposition or rivalry; v be equal or harmonize; v make equal, uniform, corresponding, or matching
translation_zh: n. 火柴；比赛（match的复数）
example: 这个使相配为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the front of the trunk from the neck to the abdomen; n. either of two soft fleshy milk-secreting glandular organs on the chest of a woman; n. meat carved from the breast of a fowl; n. the part of an animal's body that corresponds to a person's chest
translation_zh: n. 胸部, 乳房, 胸怀；vt. 以胸对着, 面对
example: He felt a pain in his breast.

meaning: n. the act of granting rights
translation_zh: n. 一致, 和谐
example: 这个一致为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. not breathing or able to breathe except with difficulty; s. tending to cause suspension of regular breathing; s. appearing dead; not breathing or having no perceptible pulse
translation_zh: a. 喘不过气来的, 屏气的, 气喘吁吁的, 无风的, 死的
example: This is a very breathless situation.

meaning: n. elegance by virtue of fineness of manner and expression; n. helping someone grow up to be an accepted member of the community; n. the production of animals or plants by inbreeding or hybridization
translation_zh: n. 教养, 生育, 饲养；[医] 生育, 繁殖, 育种, 饲养
example: The breeding was important for everyone.

meaning: n. rectangular block of clay baked by the sun or in a kiln; used as a building or paving material; n. a good fellow; helpful and trustworthy
translation_zh: n. 砖块, 积木；a. 用砖做的；vt. 用砖造, 用砖砌
example: The school is built of brick.

meaning: n motor that converts thermal energy to mechanical work; n something used to achieve a purpose; n a wheeled vehicle consisting of a self-propelled engine that is used to draw trains along railway tracks; n an instrument or machine that is used in warfare, such as a battering ram, catapult, artillery piece, etc.
translation_zh: n. 火车头；发动机, 引擎（engine的复数形式）
example: 这个引擎为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a document stating the facts and points of law of a client's case; n. a condensed written summary or abstract; v. give essential information to someone; s. of short duration or distance
translation_zh: n. 摘要, 简报；a. 简短的, 短暂的；vt. 对...作简报, 摘要, 节录
example: We had a brief discussion about the project.

meaning: r. for a short time
translation_zh: adv. 简短地, 扼要地, 简明地, 简单地
example: He spoke briefly about his plans.

meaning: n. an orderly arrangement; n. an impressive display; n. especially fine or decorative clothing; n. an arrangement of aerials spaced to give desired directional characteristics
translation_zh: n. 排列, 衣服, 大批, 军队；vt. 布署, 打扮, 排列；[计] 数组; 阵列
example: 这个衣服为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r with brightness
translation_zh: adv. 生辉地, 明亮地, 鲜明地
example: She spoke brightly during the meeting.

meaning: v to consider or examine in speech or writing; v speak with others about (something); talk (something) over in detail; have a discussion
translation_zh: v. 商讨；讨论（discuss的过去分词）
example: 这个讨论为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. of surpassing excellence; s. characterized by grandeur; s. full of light; shining intensely
translation_zh: a. 光辉的, 灿烂的, 有才气的；[机] 亮的
example: That was a brilliant idea!

meaning: n. slang term for a woman; s. not detailed or specific; s. lacking subtlety; obvious; s. being at a peak or culminating point
translation_zh: a. 宽广的, 辽阔的, 广大的, 显著的；adv. 宽阔地；n. 宽阔部分
example: The river is very broad at this point.

meaning: n. English writer (1832-1904)
translation_zh: n. 斯蒂芬（男子名）
example: 这个stephen（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. message that is transmitted by radio or television; n. a radio or television show; v. sow over a wide area, especially by hand
translation_zh: n. 广播, 传播；a. 广播的；v. 广播；adv. 经广播, 四散地；[计] 广播命令, 广播
example: The concert will be broadcast live (= at the same time as it takes place) tomorrow evening.

meaning: n. daughter of George VI who became the Queen of England and Northern Ireland in 1952 on the death of her father (1926-); n. Queen of England from 1558 to 1603; daughter of Henry VIII and Anne Boleyn; she succeeded Mary I (who was a Catholic) and restored Protestantism to England; during her reign Mary Queen of Scots was executed and the Spanish Armada was defeated; her reign was marked by prosperity and literary genius (1533-1603)
translation_zh: n. 伊丽莎白（女子名）
example: 这个elizabeth（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. plant with dense clusters of tight green flower buds; n. branched green undeveloped flower heads
