translation_zh: n. 契约( contract的名词复数 ); 婚约; [法律]契约法; 行贿
example: 这个感染为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the social process whereby societies achieve an advanced stage of development and organization; n a particular society at a particular time and place; n a society in an advanced state of social development (e.g., with complex legal and political and religious organizations); n the quality of excellence in thought and manners and taste
translation_zh: n. 文明, 文明世界, 文化, 开化, 教化
example: Ancient Egypt was a highly advanced civilisation.

meaning: n a visitor to whom hospitality is extended; n United States journalist (born in England) noted for his syndicated homey verse (1881-1959); n a customer of a hotel or restaurant etc.; n (computer science) any computer that is hooked up to a computer network
translation_zh: n. 客人；来宾（guest的复数）
example: 这个客人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a society in an advanced state of social development (e.g., with complex legal and political and religious organizations); n. the social process whereby societies achieve an advanced stage of development and organization
translation_zh: n. 文明, 教化；[法] 文明, 文化, 文明国家的总称
example: The Victorians regarded the railways as bringing progress and civilization.

meaning: v be the host of or for
translation_zh: v. （作为主人）款待, 招待（客人）；主持（host的过去式）
example: 这个主人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a creation of the highest excellence; n. an artist who has created classic works
translation_zh: n. 古典作品, 杰作, 大艺术家；a. 第一流的, 最优秀的, 古典的
example: This is a classic example of his work.

meaning: n an impairment of health or a condition of abnormal functioning
translation_zh: n. 病害；疾病；疾病种类；病（disease的复数）
example: 这个病为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. of or relating to the most highly developed stage of an earlier civilisation and its culture; a. of or relating to the study of the literary works of ancient Greece and Rome; s. (language) having the form used by ancient standard authors; s. of or pertaining to or characteristic of the ancient Greek and Roman cultures
translation_zh: a. 古典的, 正统派的, 经典的；[医] 古典的; 标准的, 典型的
example: These are classical examples of food allergy.

meaning: v. arrange or order by classes or categories; v. declare unavailable, as for security reasons
translation_zh: vt. 分类, 归类, 分等；[建] 分类, 分级, 分粒
example: We need to classify this carefully.

meaning: n. someone who develops real estate (especially someone who prepares a site for residential or commercial use); n. photographic equipment consisting of a chemical solution for developing film
translation_zh: n. 开发者( developer的复数形式 ); 研制者; 显影剂; 显色剂
example: 这个开发者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who seeks the advice of a lawyer
translation_zh: n. 客户, 顾客, 委托人；[计] 客户, 客户机, 客户机程序
example: Our company has many international clients.

meaning: n. a person or thing equal to another in value or measure or force or effect or significance etc; n. the atomic weight of an element that has the same combining capacity as a given weight of another element; the standard is 8 for oxygen; s. being essentially equal to something
translation_zh: n. 同等物, 等价物, 相等物；a. 相等的, 相当的, 同意义的；[计] 等价的
example: 这个等同的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a steep high face of rock
translation_zh: n. 悬崖, 绝壁
example: We set off along the cliff path.

meaning: n. the weather in some location averaged over some long period of time; n. the prevailing psychological state
translation_zh: n. 气候, 社会趋势, 气候区；[医] 气候
example: The climate in this region is very mild.

meaning: n. A simpleton.
translation_zh: a. 高贵的, 时髦的
example: 这个tony（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a vine or climbing plant that readily grows up a support or over other plants; n. someone who climbs as a sport; especially someone who climbs mountains
translation_zh: n. 登山者；[电] 登杆器
example: The mountain climber reached the summit.

meaning: n. a medical establishment run by a group of medical specialists; n. meeting for diagnosis of problems and instruction or remedial work in a particular activity; n. a healthcare facility for outpatient care
translation_zh: n. 诊所, 临床教学；[医] 诊所(门诊部); 临床(讲解); 临床(学)科
example: Your local family planning clinic can give you advice about birth control.

meaning: n. a state in the southwestern United States
translation_zh: n. 内华达
example: 这个nevada（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any of various small fasteners used to hold loose articles together; n. an article of jewelry that can be clipped onto a hat or dress; n. the act of clipping or snipping; n. a sharp slanting blow
translation_zh: n. 修剪, 夹子, 回形针, 剪下来的东西；vt. 修剪, 痛打, 夹牢, 剪报；vi. 剪报
example: She used a paper clip to hold the documents together.

meaning: n a case for containing a set of articles; n gear consisting of a set of articles or tools for a specified purpose; n young of any of various fur-bearing animals; v supply with a set of articles or tools
translation_zh: n. 装备；小桶；锦囊（kit的复数）
example: 这个工具箱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in a close relation or position in time or space; r. in a close manner
translation_zh: adv. 接近地
example: They worked closely together on the project.

meaning: n. a country of southeastern Asia that extends southward along the Isthmus of Kra to the Malay Peninsula
translation_zh: n. 泰国
example: 这个thailand（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (sports) someone in charge of training an athlete or a team; n. a person who gives private instruction (as in singing, acting, etc.); n. a carriage pulled by four horses with one driver; v. teach and supervise (someone); act as a trainer or coach (to), as in sports
translation_zh: n. 四轮大马车, 教练；vt. 训练, 指导；vi. 坐马车旅行, 作指导
example: The football coach gave a motivational speech.

meaning: n something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation; n a quantity that can assume any of a set of values; n a star that varies noticeably in brightness; n a symbol (like x or y) that is used in mathematical or logical expressions to represent a variable quantity
translation_zh: n. 变量
example: 这个易变的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. fossil fuel consisting of carbonized vegetable matter deposited in the Carboniferous period; v. supply with coal; v. take in coal
translation_zh: n. 煤, 木炭；v. 加煤
example: Coal is a fossil fuel used to generate electricity.

meaning: a. of or relating to a coast; a. located on or near or bordering on a coast
translation_zh: a. 海岸的, 沿海的, 沿岸的；[法] 海岸的, 沿海的
example: This is a very coastal situation.

meaning: n. lean white flesh of important North Atlantic food fish; usually baked or poached; n. major food fish of Arctic and cold-temperate waters
translation_zh: n. 鳕, 欺骗, 愚弄；v. 欺骗, 愚弄
example: We had baked cod for dinner.

meaning: v continue a certain state, condition, or activity; v continue talking; v keep or maintain in unaltered condition; cause to remain or last; v move ahead; travel onward in time or space; v allow to remain in a place or position or maintain a property or feature; v do something repeatedly and showing no intention to stop; v continue after an interruption; v continue in a place, position, or situation; v span an interval of distance, space or time; v exist over a prolonged period of time
translation_zh: v. 继续；扩展；连续（continue的三单形式）
example: 这个仍旧为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a set of rules or principles or laws (especially written ones); n. a coding system used for transmitting messages requiring brevity or secrecy; n. (computer science) the symbolic arrangement of data or instructions in a computer program or the set of such instructions; v. attach a code to
translation_zh: n. 代码, 密码, 法规, 法典；vt. 把...编码；[计] 代码
example: He wrote the code for the new software.

meaning: n a line or route along which something travels or moves; n evidence pointing to a possible solution; n a pair of parallel rails providing a runway for wheels; n a course over which races are run; n a distinct selection of music from a recording or a compact disc; n an endless metal belt on which tracked vehicles move over the ground; n (computer science) one of the circular magnetic paths on a magnetic disk that serve as a guide for writing and reading data; n a groove on a phonograph recording; n a bar or pair of parallel bars of rolled steel making the railway along which railroad cars or other vehicles can roll; n any road or path affording passage especially a rough one; n the act of participating in an athletic competition involving running on a track; v carry on the feet and deposit; v observe or plot the moving path of something; v go after with the intent to catch; v travel across or pass over; v make tracks upon
translation_zh: n. 轮胎；磁道；轨道（track的复数）
example: 这个足迹为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. box in which a corpse is buried or cremated; v. place into a coffin
translation_zh: n. 棺材, 灵柩；vt. 把...装进棺材
example: The coffin was important for everyone.

meaning: n. an abrupt failure of function or complete physical exhaustion; n. a natural event caused by something suddenly falling down or caving in; v. break down, literally or metaphorically; v. fold or close up
translation_zh: n. 崩溃, 倒塌, 虚脱；vi. 倒塌, 崩溃, 瓦解；vt. 使倒塌, 折叠；[计] 折叠
example: The roof collapsed under the weight of snow.

meaning: n. a river in east central England that flows past Cambridge to join the Ouse River; n. a rotating disk shaped to convert circular into linear motion
translation_zh: n. 凸轮, 计算机辅助制造, 中央地址存储器；[计] 计算机辅助制造; 计算机辅助生产
example: 这个凸轮为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a band that fits around the neck and is usually folded over; n. (zoology) an encircling band or marking around the neck of any animal; n. anything worn or placed about the neck; n. a short ring fastened over a rod or shaft to limit, guide, or secure a machine part
translation_zh: n. 衣领, 颈圈；vt. 控制, 扭住衣领, 给...装上领子
example: I turned up my collar against the wind (= to keep warm).

meaning: n. several things grouped together or considered as a whole; n. a publication containing a variety of works; n. the act of gathering something together
translation_zh: n. 收集, 采集, (一批)收藏品, 募捐；[医] 收集; 收集品, 标本
example: He has a large collection of stamps.

meaning: n. the body of faculty and students of a college; n. an institution of higher education created to educate and grant degrees; often a part of a university; n. a complex of buildings in which an institution of higher education is housed
translation_zh: n. 学院, 大学, 学会
example: She is studying at college.

meaning: n. a model or standard for making comparisons
translation_zh: n. 样板, 模板, 垫木；[计] 模板
example: Use this template to create your presentation.

meaning: n. a journalist who writes editorials
translation_zh: n. 专栏作家
example: She's a columnist for USA Today.

meaning: n. a collection of things that have been combined; an assemblage of separate parts or qualities; n. a coordinated sequence of chess moves; n. a sequence of numbers or letters that opens a combination lock; n. a group of people (often temporary) having a common purpose
translation_zh: n. 组合, 合并, 联合；[计] 组合图
example: The dish was a delicious combination of flavors.

meaning: n. harvester that heads and threshes and cleans grain while moving across the field; v. add together from different sources; v. join for a common purpose or in a common action
translation_zh: v. (使)联合, (使)结合；n. (企业的)联合, 联合收割机
example: You can combine these ingredients.

meaning: n. a professional performer who tells jokes and performs comical acts; n. an actor in a comedy
translation_zh: n. 喜剧演员
example: The comedian had the audience laughing throughout the show.

meaning: n any monetary aid; n the act of providing a subsidy; n (law) a transfer of property by deed of conveyance; n Scottish painter; cousin of Lytton Strachey and member of the Bloomsbury Group (1885-1978); n United States actor (born in England) who was the elegant leading man in many films (1904-1986); n 18th President of the United States; commander of the Union armies in the American Civil War (1822-1885); n a contract granting the right to operate a subsidiary business; n a right or privilege that has been granted; v let have; v give as judged due or on the basis of merit; v be willing to concede; v allow to have; v bestow, especially officially; v give over; surrender or relinquish to the physical control of another; v transfer by deed
translation_zh: [经] 补助金, 拨款, 津贴
example: 这个授予为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (astronomy) a relatively small extraterrestrial body consisting of a frozen mass that travels around the sun in a highly elliptical orbit
translation_zh: n. 彗星
example: Halley's Comet is visible from Earth every 75-76 years.

meaning: n. a state of being relaxed and feeling no pain; n. a feeling of freedom from worry or disappointment; n. satisfaction or physical well-being provided by a person or thing; n. assistance, such as that provided to an enemy or to a known criminal
translation_zh: n. 舒适, 安慰, 安慰者；vt. 安慰
example: She found comfort in her old blanket.

meaning: n. a punctuation mark (,) used to indicate the separation of elements within the grammatical structure of a sentence; n. anglewing butterfly with a comma-shaped mark on the underside of each hind wing
translation_zh: n. 逗点, 逗号
example: The relative clause is separated by commas.

meaning: n a result; n a bodily process occurring due to the effect of some antecedent stimulus or agent; n a statement (either spoken or written) that is made to reply to a question or request or criticism or accusation; n the manner in which something is greeted; n a phrase recited or sung by the congregation following a versicle by the priest or minister; n the speech act of continuing a conversational exchange; n the manner in which an electrical or mechanical device responds to an input signal or a range of input signals
translation_zh: n. 响应回应
example: 这个反应为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a commercially sponsored ad on radio or television; a. connected with or engaged in or sponsored by or used in commerce or commercial enterprises; a. of or relating to commercialism; s. of the kind or quality used in commerce; average or inferior
translation_zh: a. 商业的, 商用的, 商品化的；n. 商业广告节目
example: The area is zoned for commercial use.

meaning: See Common sense, under Sense.
translation_zh: 常识
example: The common sense was important for everyone.

meaning: r under normal conditions
translation_zh: adv. 一般, 普通, 通常
example: She spoke commonly during the meeting.

meaning: n. a person's financial situation (good or bad)
translation_zh: [法] 事件, 事项, 详细情节
example: 这个条件为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the activity of communicating; the activity of conveying information; n. something that is communicated by or to or between people or groups; n. a connection allowing access between persons or places
translation_zh: n. 交流, 交通, 通讯；[计] 通信
example: Good communication is key to success.

meaning: n. King of England and Ireland in 1936; his marriage to Wallis Warfield Simpson created a constitutional crisis leading to his abdication (1894-1972); n. King of England from 1901 to 1910; son of Victoria and Prince Albert; famous for his elegant sporting ways (1841-1910); n. King of England and Ireland from 1547 to 1553; son of Henry VIII and Jane Seymour; died of tuberculosis (1537-1553)
translation_zh: n. 爱德华（男子名）
example: 这个edward（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a group of people living in a particular local area; n. common ownership; n. a group of nations having common interests; n. agreement as to goals
translation_zh: n. 社区, 公众, 共有, 共同体；[经] 公众, 共有, 社会
example: The local community is very supportive.

meaning: n. a friend who is frequently in the company of another; n. a traveler who accompanies you; n. one paid to accompany or assist or live with another
translation_zh: n. 朋友, 陪伴, 指南, 升降口围罩；vt. 陪伴
example: Geoff was my companion on the journey.

meaning: v. examine and note the similarities or differences of; v. be comparable; v. consider or describe as similar, equal, or analogous; v. to form the comparative or superlative form on an adjective or adverb
translation_zh: vt. 比较, 比喻, 对照；vi. 相比；n. 比较；[计] 比较
example: Let's compare the two options.

meaning: n. the act of examining resemblances; n. relation based on similarities and differences; n. qualities that are comparable
translation_zh: n. 比较, 对照, 比喻；[经] 比较, 对比
example: There's no comparison between the two products.

meaning: n the act of departing; v go away from a place; v go and leave behind, either intentionally or by neglect or forgetfulness; v act or be so as to become in a specified state; v leave unchanged or undisturbed or refrain from taking; v move out of or depart from; v make a possibility or provide opportunity for; permit to be attainable or cause to remain; v have as a result or residue; v remove oneself from an association with or participation in; v put into the care or protection of someone; v leave or give by will after one's death; v have left or have as a remainder; v be survived by after one's death; v transmit (knowledge or skills); v leave behind unintentionally
translation_zh: n. 离开；残余；渣滓
example: 这个离开v.离开( leave的现在分词 )为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. compete for something; engage in a contest; measure oneself against others
translation_zh: vi. 竞争, 对抗
example: Athletes compete for gold medals.

meaning: n. a business relation in which two parties compete to gain customers; n. the act of competing as for profit or a prize
translation_zh: n. 竞争, 竞赛；[经] 竞争, 竞销, 比赛
example: There is strong competition for the job.

meaning: n a device or control that is very useful for a particular job; n durable goods for home or office use
translation_zh: 电气用具
example: 这个器具为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the contestant you hope to defeat
translation_zh: n. 竞争者；[经] 竞争者, 竞争对手
example: Our main competitor just released a similar product.

meaning: n the property of having little or no contrast; lacking highlights or gloss; s not reflecting light; not glossy
translation_zh: a. 表面暗淡的, 无光泽的, 表面粗糙的, 不光滑的；[医] 无光泽
example: 这个matt（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a word or phrase used to complete a grammatical construction; n. a complete number or quantity; n. number needed to make up a whole force; n. something added to complete or embellish or make perfect
translation_zh: n. 补足物, 补语, 补数；vt. 补充, 补足；[计] 补码; 反相器; 补数
example: The excellent menu is complemented by a good wine list.

meaning: v. come or bring to a finish or an end; others finished in over 4 hours"; v. bring to a whole, with all the necessary parts or elements; v. complete a pass; v. write all the required information onto a form
translation_zh: a. 完全的, 十足的, 完成的；vt. 完成, 完工, 使圆满
example: The puzzle is now complete.

meaning: r. so as to be complete; with everything necessary
translation_zh: adv. 完全地, 十分地, 圆满地
example: I completely forgot about the meeting.

meaning: n. the utterance of intelligible speech; a. capable of or involving speech or speaking
translation_zh: n. 谈话, 演说；a. 讲话的, 适于说的, 讲某种语言的
example: 这个说话为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. difficult to analyze or understand
translation_zh: a. 复杂的；[医] 并发的
example: The instructions look very complicated.

meaning: n someone who supports or champions something; n an advocate who presents a person (as for an award or a degree or an introduction etc.); v assume sponsorship of; v assume responsibility for or leadership of; v do one's shopping at; do business with; be a customer or client of
translation_zh: n. 保人( sponsor的名词复数 ); （广播电视节目、音乐会或运动会的）赞助者; （培训或教育的）资助者; （法案等的）倡议者；v. 赞助( sponsor的第三人称单数 ); 资助（某人的培训或教育）; 为慈善活动捐资; 倡议
example: 这个发起者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a remark (or act) expressing praise and admiration; v. say something to someone that expresses praise; v. express respect or esteem for
translation_zh: n. 称赞, 恭维, 敬意；vt. 称赞, 褒扬, 恭维
example: She received a compliment on her new hairstyle.

meaning: v. form the substance of; v. write music; v. put together out of existing material; v. calm (someone, especially oneself); make quiet
translation_zh: vt. 组成, 写作, 作曲, 使平静；vi. 创作, 排字；[计] 编写
example: We need to compose this carefully.

meaning: n. the spatial property resulting from the arrangement of parts in relation to each other and to the whole; n. a mixture of ingredients; n. an essay (especially one written as an assignment); n. something that is created by arranging several things to form a unified whole
translation_zh: n. 作文, 创作, 组成；[化] 成分; 组成
example: In the exam you will have to do a composition.

meaning: n. a whole formed by a union of two or more elements or parts; n. (chemistry) a substance formed by chemical union of two or more elements or ingredients in definite proportion by weight; n. an enclosure of residences and other building (especially in the Orient); v. put or add together
translation_zh: n. 混合物, 复合词, 化合物, 院子；a. 复合的, 混合的, 化合的；vi. 化合, 和解, 妥协；vt. 使复合, 使化合
example: The air smelled like a compound of diesel and petrol fumes.

meaning: n the physical magnitude of something (how big it is); n the property resulting from being one of a series of graduated measurements (as of clothing); n any glutinous material used to fill pores in surfaces or to stiffen fabrics; n the actual state of affairs; n a large magnitude; v cover or stiffen or glaze a porous material with size or sizing (a glutinous substance); v sort according to size; v make to a size; bring to a suitable size
translation_zh: n. 象素显示尺寸, 尺寸（size复数形式）
example: 这个大小为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a middle way between two extremes; n. an accommodation in which both sides make concessions; v. make a compromise; arrive at a compromise; we all must compromise"; v. settle by concession
translation_zh: n. 妥协, 折中, 折中方案, 和解；vi. 妥协处理；vt. 危害
example: After lengthy talks the two sides finally reached a compromise.

meaning: n. the strength of a solution; number of molecules of a substance in a given volume; n. the spatial property of being crowded together; n. strengthening the concentration (as of a solute in a mixture) by removing diluting material; n. increase in density
translation_zh: n. 集中, 专心；[化] 浓度; 浓缩
example: This book requires a great deal of concentration.

meaning: a. feeling or showing worry or solicitude; s. involved in or affected by or having a claim to or share in
translation_zh: a. 关心的, 有关的, 参与的, 担心的
example: Concerned citizens can have a huge impact.

meaning: v to come or go into; v become a participant; be involved in; v register formally as a participant or member; v be or play a part of or in; v make a record of; set down in permanent form; v come on stage; v take on duties or office; v put or introduce into something; v set out on (an enterprise or subject of study)
translation_zh: a. 进入的
example: 这个& vi. 进入为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. bring to a close; v. reach a conclusion after a discussion or deliberation; v. come to a close; v. reach agreement on
translation_zh: vt. 结束, 作结论, 推断；vi. 结束, 推断
example: We need to conclude this carefully.

meaning: n. a theocratic Islamic republic in the Middle East in western Asia; Iran was the core of the ancient empire that was known as Persia until 1935; rich in oil
translation_zh: n. 伊朗
example: 这个iran（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an intuitive assumption; n. the proposition arrived at by logical reasoning (such as the proposition that must follow from the major and minor premises of a syllogism); n. a final settlement; n. the last section of a communication
translation_zh: n. 结论, 结尾, 推论；[法] 缔结, 结论, 推论
example: In conclusion, we need to work together.

meaning: n. a state at a particular time; n. an assumption on which rests the validity or effect of something else; n. a mode of being or form of existence of a person or thing; n. the state of (good) health (especially in the phrases `in condition' or `in shape' or `out of condition' or `out of shape')
translation_zh: n. 情况, 条件；vt. 使健康, 以...为条件, 决定, 使适应；[计] 条件
example: The car is in excellent condition.

meaning: n metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock the lock's mechanism can be rotated; n something crucial for explaining; n pitch of the voice; n any of 24 major or minor diatonic scales that provide the tonal framework for a piece of music; n a kilogram of a narcotic drug; n a winged often one-seed indehiscent fruit as of the ash or elm or maple; n United States lawyer and poet who wrote a poem after witnessing the British attack on Baltimore during the War of 1812; the poem was later set to music and entitled `The Star-Spangled Banner' (1779-1843); n a coral reef off the southern coast of Florida; n (basketball) a space (including the foul line) in front of the basket at each end of a basketball court; usually painted a different color from the rest of the court; n a list of answers to a test; n a list of words or phrases that explain symbols or abbreviations; n a generic term for any device whose possession entitles the holder to a means of access; n mechanical device used to wind another device that is driven by a spring (as a clock); n the central building block at the top of an arch or vault; n a lever (as in a keyboard) that actuates a mechanism when depressed; v identify as in botany or biology, for example; v provide with a key; v vandalize a car by scratching the sides with a key; v regulate the musical pitch of; v harmonize with or adjust to
translation_zh: n. 关键帧；（钢琴等的）键；密钥（key的复数）
example: 这个钥匙为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a prearranged meeting for consultation or exchange of information or discussion (especially one with a formal agenda); n. a discussion among participants who have an agreed (serious) topic
translation_zh: n. 会议；[经] 会议, 讨论会, 协商会
example: They attended a business conference.

meaning: n. a feeling of trust (in someone or something); n. a state of confident hopefulness that events will be favorable; n. a trustful relationship; n. a secret that is confided or entrusted to another
translation_zh: n. 信心；[电] 可靠
example: She spoke with great confidence.

meaning: v. establish or strengthen as with new evidence or facts; v. strengthen or make more firm; v. make more firm; v. support a person for a position
translation_zh: vt. 证实, 确定, 批准, 使巩固；[计] 确认
example: Can you confirm your reservation?

meaning: v examine so as to determine accuracy, quality, or condition; v make an examination or investigation; v be careful or certain to do something; make certain of something; v lessen the intensity of; temper; hold in restraint; hold or keep within limits; v stop for a moment, as if out of uncertainty or caution; v put a check mark on or near or next to; v slow the growth or development of; v be verified or confirmed; pass inspection; v be compatible, similar or consistent; coincide in their characteristics; v block or impede (a player from the opposing team) in ice hockey; v develop (children's) behavior by instruction and practice; especially to teach self-control; v consign for shipment on a vehicle; v hand over something to somebody as for temporary safekeeping; v abandon the intended prey, turn, and pursue an inferior prey; v stop in a chase especially when scent is lost; v mark into squares or draw squares on; draw crossed lines on; v decline to initiate betting; v hold back, as of a danger or an enemy; check the expansion or influence of; v place into check; v write out a check on a bank account; v find out, learn, or determine with certainty, usually by making an inquiry or other effort; v verify by consulting a source or authority; v arrest the motion (of something) abruptly; v make cracks or chinks in; v become fractured; break or crack on the surface only
translation_zh: [计] 检查的；[化] 校核; 检验; 浅裂纹
example: 这个校核为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. additional proof that something that was believed (some fact or hypothesis or theory) is correct; n. information that confirms or verifies; n. a ceremony held in the synagogue (usually at Pentecost) to admit as adult members of the Jewish community young men and women who have successfully completed a course of study in Judaism
translation_zh: n. 证实, 证明, 批准, 确认；[计] 确认
example: I'm still waiting for confirmation of the test results.

meaning: n. a riblike part of a plant or animal (such as a middle rib of a leaf or a thickened vein of an insect wing)
translation_zh: n. 肋骨, 肋脉, 叶的中脉；[医] 肋
example: 这个costa（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. causing confusion or disorientation; s. lacking clarity of meaning; causing confusion or perplexity
translation_zh: a. 令人困惑的；混淆的；混乱的
example: This is a very confusing situation.

meaning: n. a monarchy in northwestern Europe; headquarters for the European Union and for the North Atlantic Treaty Organization
translation_zh: n. 比利时
example: 这个belgium（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. disorder resulting from a failure to behave predictably; n. a mental state characterized by a lack of clear and orderly thought and behavior; n. a feeling of embarrassment that leaves you confused; n. an act causing a disorderly combination of elements with identities lost and distinctions blended
translation_zh: n. 混乱, 混淆, 无秩序；[计] 含混
example: There was a lot of confusion about the new rules.

meaning: a. fit for publication because free of material that is morally or legally objectionable
translation_zh: a. 可印刷的, 适于出版的
example: The document is available in a printable format.

meaning: v. express congratulations
translation_zh: vt. 祝贺, 庆贺
example: I want to congratulate you on your excellent exam results.

meaning: n. a relation between things or events (as in the case of one causing the other or sharing features with it); n. the state of being connected; n. an instrumentality that connects; n. (usually plural) a person who is influential and to whom you are connected in some way (as by family or friendship)
translation_zh: n. 连接, 关系, 前后关系；[计] 连接
example: There's a strong connection between diet and health.

meaning: n a New Testament book describing the development of the early church from Christ's Ascension to Paul's sojourn at Rome; n a legal document codifying the result of deliberations of a committee or society or legislative body; n something that people do or cause to happen; n a subdivision of a play or opera or ballet; n a short theatrical performance that is part of a longer program; n a manifestation of insincerity; v perform an action, or work out or perform (an action); v behave in a certain manner; show a certain behavior; conduct or comport oneself; v play a role or part; v discharge one's duties; v pretend to have certain qualities or state of mind; v be suitable for theatrical performance; v have an effect or outcome; often the one desired or expected; v be engaged in an activity, often for no particular purpose other than pleasure; v behave unnaturally or affectedly; v perform on a stage or theater
translation_zh: abbr. 声控遥测系统（Acoustic Control and Telemetry System）；声控制与遥测系统（Acoustic Control and Telemetry System）
example: 这个& vi. 行动为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a connecting shape; n a relation between things or events (as in the case of one causing the other or sharing features with it); n the process of bringing ideas or events together in memory or imagination; n an instrumentality that connects; n shifting from one form of transportation to another; n the act of bringing two things into contact (especially for communication)
translation_zh: n. 连接, 团体, 生意合伙人, 亲戚
example: The connexion was important for everyone.

meaning: v. overcome by conquest
translation_zh: vt. 克服, 征服, 战胜；vi. 得胜
example: We need to conquer this carefully.

meaning: s. intentionally conceived; a. knowing and perceiving; having awareness of surroundings and sensations and thoughts; s. (followed by `of') showing realization or recognition of something
translation_zh: a. 有意识的, 知觉的, 觉察的；[医] 有意识的, 清醒的
example: She's very conscious of the problems involved.

meaning: r. (sentence connectors) because of the reason given; r. as a consequence
translation_zh: adv. 所以
example: She spoke consequently during the meeting.

meaning: n. the act of enforcing; ensuring observance of or obedience to
translation_zh: n. 执行, 强制；[法] 实施, 加强, 厉行
example: 这个强制为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an occurrence of improvement by virtue of preventing loss or injury or other change; n. the preservation and careful management of the environment and of natural resources; n. (physics) the maintenance of a certain quantities unchanged during chemical reactions or physical transformations
translation_zh: n. 保护, 保存；[医] 保存
example: Road development in the area has been severely affected by the conservation programmes of the council.

meaning: v. take into consideration for exemplifying purposes; v. show consideration for; take into account; v. think about carefully; weigh; v. regard or treat with consideration, respect, and esteem
translation_zh: v. 考虑, 思考, 认为
example: Please consider my offer.

meaning: n the skilled practice of a practical occupation; n a vehicle designed for navigation in or on water or air or through outer space; n people who perform a particular kind of skilled work; n skill in an occupation or trade; n shrewdness as demonstrated by being skilled in deception; v make by hand and with much skill
translation_zh: n. 工艺品, 手艺（craft的复数形式）
example: 这个手艺为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. large or relatively large in number or amount or extent or degree
translation_zh: a. 相当的, 可观的, 重要的
example: The project wasted a considerable amount of time and money.

meaning: n. the process of giving careful thought to something; n. a discussion of a topic (as in a meeting); n. kind and considerate regard for others; n. a considerate and thoughtful act
translation_zh: n. 考虑, 原因；[法] 考虑, 思考, 报酬
example: An employer is legally bound to give due consideration to the request.

meaning: n. a speech sound that is not a vowel; n. a letter of the alphabet standing for a spoken consonant; s. involving or characterized by harmony
translation_zh: n. 辅音；a. 一致的, 调和的
example: The English alphabet has 21 consonants.

meaning: n a book with cardboard or cloth or leather covers; s having a hard back or cover
translation_zh: a. 硬书皮的；n. 硬封面的书, 精装书
example: I prefer to buy the hardcover edition of books.

meaning: r. without variation or change, in every case; r. without interruption
translation_zh: adv. 不变地, 不断地, 时常地
example: He is constantly checking his phone.

meaning: v discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of; v make mention of; v observe with care or pay close attention to; v watch attentively; v show respect towards; v behave as expected during of holidays or rites; v follow with the eyes or the mind; v stick to correctly or closely; v conform one's action or practice to; s discovered or determined by scientific observation
translation_zh: a. 观测的；观察的
example: 这个观察为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. form or compose
translation_zh: vt. 构成, 组成, 任命；[建] 构造, 组成
example: We need to constitute this carefully.

meaning: n. an administrator in charge of a division of a university or college; n. United States film actor whose moody rebellious roles made him a cult figure (1931-1955); n. a man who is the senior member of a group; n. (Roman Catholic Church) the head of the College of Cardinals
translation_zh: n. 院长, 主持牧师；[法] 外交团长, 学院院长, 教务长
example: 这个（大学的）学院院长为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. make by combining materials and parts; v. draw with suitable instruments and under specified conditions; v. create by linking linguistic units; v. create by organizing and linking ideas, arguments, or concepts
translation_zh: vt. 构造, 建造, 对...进行构思, 作图；n. 构成物
example: We need to construct this carefully.

meaning: n. the way something is organized or arranged
translation_zh: n. 装备, 组织, 计划, 机构, 调整, 设置；[计] 设置
example: The setup of the new office is very efficient.

meaning: n. the act of constructing something; n. a group of words that form a constituent of a sentence and are considered as a single unit; n. the creation of a construct; the process of combining ideas into a congruous object of thought; n. drawing a figure satisfying certain conditions as part of solving a problem or proving a theorem
translation_zh: n. 建筑, 构造, 建筑物；[化] 施工
example: The new building is still under construction.

meaning: n. an inquiry into public opinion conducted by interviewing a random sample of people; n. the part of the head between the ears; n. a tame parrot; n. the counting of votes (as in an election)
translation_zh: n. 投票, 民意测验, 选举投票, 投票数, 一组人中的一个, 头颈和后脑部, 鹦鹉；vt. 对...进行民意测验, 获得...票, 剪树枝, 轮询；vi. 投票；a. 剪过毛的, 修过枝的；[计] 轮询
example: The latest poll shows a shift in public opinion.

meaning: v. serve oneself to, or consume regularly; v. spend extravagantly; v. destroy completely; v. use up (resources or materials)
translation_zh: vt. 消耗, 消费, 消灭；vi. 耗尽, 毁灭
example: We consume a lot of electricity.

meaning: n. a person who uses goods or services
translation_zh: n. 消费者；[经] 消费者, 用户
example: Consumers are demanding more eco-friendly products.

meaning: n. an alphabetical list of technical terms in some specialized field of knowledge; usually published as an appendix to a text on that field
translation_zh: n. 专业词典, 术语集, 词表；[计] 图文集
example: Check the glossary at the back of the book for the meaning of unfamiliar words.

meaning: n. the process of taking food into the body through the mouth (as by eating); n. (economics) the utilization of economic goods to satisfy needs or in manufacturing; n. the act of consuming something
translation_zh: n. 消费, 消费量, 痨病；[化] 消耗量; 耗量
example: Gas and oil consumption always increases in cold weather.

meaning: n. close interaction; n. the act of touching physically; n. the state or condition of touching or of being in immediate proximity; n. the physical coming together of two or more things
translation_zh: n. 联系, 交际, 熟人, 接触；vi. 接触, 联系；vt. 使接触
example: Please keep in contact with us.

meaning: v. be divisible by; v. be capable of holding or containing
translation_zh: vt. 包含, 容纳, 控制；vi. 自制
example: The box contains old letters.

meaning: n how something is done or how it happens; n a way of expressing something (in language or art or music etc.) that is characteristic of a particular person or group of people or period; n a particular kind (as to appearance); n the popular taste at a given time; n (botany) the narrow elongated part of the pistil between the ovary and the stigma; n editorial directions to be followed in spelling and punctuation and capitalization and typographical display; n distinctive and stylish elegance; n a pointed tool for writing or drawing or engraving; n a slender bristlelike or tubular process; v designate by an identifying term; v make consistent with a certain fashion or style; v make consistent with certain rules of style
translation_zh: n. 风格；样式；模式（style的复数形式）
example: 这个风格为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. everything that is included in a collection and that is held or included in something; n. the proportion of a substance that is contained in a mixture or alloy etc.; n. the sum or range of what has been perceived, discovered, or learned; v. satisfy in a limited way
translation_zh: n. 内容, 满足, 意义, 要旨；a. 满足的, 满意的；vt. 使...满足, 使...安心；[计] 内容
example: The book has interesting content.

meaning: n. the state capital and largest city of Colorado; located in central Colorado on the South Platte river
translation_zh: n. 丹佛(美国城市)
example: 这个denver（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants; n. a struggle between rivals; v. to make the subject of dispute, contention, or litigation
translation_zh: n. 竞赛, 争论；vt. 竞争, 争取, 争辩；vi. 竞争
example: She won the singing contest.

meaning: n. trademark for a powerful operating system
translation_zh: n. Unix 操作系统（可供多人同时使用）；[网络] 系统常用命令；一种计算机操作系统
example: 这个unix（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. occurring without interruption; chiefly restricted to what recurs regularly or frequently in a prolonged and closely spaced series; s. `continual' (meaning seemingly uninterrupted) is often used interchangeably with `continuous' (meaning without interruption)
translation_zh: a. 持续不断的, 继续的；[建] 连续的
example: He was in a continual process of rewriting his material.

meaning: s. (usually followed by `with' or used as a combining form) generously supplied with; a. of purchase orders that have been filled; s. (of time) taken up
translation_zh: a. 加满的；装满的；满的
example: 这个装满为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. seemingly without interruption
translation_zh: adv. 不断地, 频繁地
example: She spoke continually during the meeting.

meaning: a. continuing in time or space without interruption; a. of a function or curve; extending without break or irregularity
translation_zh: a. 连续的, 继续的, 连续不断的；[计] 连续的
example: Recovery after the accident will be a continuous process that may take several months.

meaning: n. official routes of communication
translation_zh: n. 通道；水槽；隧道；频道；录音声道（channel的复数形式）
example: 这个引导为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. at every point
translation_zh: adv. 不断地, 连续地；[电] 连续地
example: She spoke continuously during the meeting.

meaning: ericsson
translation_zh: n. 爱立信公司
example: 这个ericsson（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. exact opposition; n. a logical relation such that two propositions are contraries if both cannot be true but both can be false; s. very opposed in nature or character or purpose; s. of words or propositions so related that both cannot be true but both may be false
translation_zh: a. 相反的, 矛盾的, 对立的；n. 相反, 对立面；adv. 相反地
example: I was worried that it might be too hard for me but it turned out the contrary was true.

meaning: n. supplementary material that is collected and appended at the back of a book; n. a vestigial process that extends from the lower end of the cecum and that resembles a small pouch
translation_zh: n. 附录, 附加物, 阑尾；[化] 增补
example: You can find more details in the appendix at the back of the book.

meaning: v. contribute to some cause; v. be conducive to
translation_zh: vt. 有助于, 捐助, 投稿；vi. 出力, 捐献, 投稿
example: Everyone should contribute to the project.

meaning: v inform (somebody) of something
translation_zh: vt. 通知, 通告, 报告；[计] 通知
example: Please notify me if there are any changes.

meaning: n. the part played by a person in bringing about a result; n. a voluntary gift (as of money or service or ideas) made to some worthwhile cause; n. act of giving in common with others for a common purpose especially to a charity; n. an amount of money contributed
translation_zh: n. 捐助, 捐助之物, 贡献；[经] 贡献, 捐款, 补助品
example: Her contribution to the project was significant.

meaning: n. a type of folksong that originated among Black Americans at the beginning of the 20th century; has a melancholy sound from repeated use of blue notes; n. a state of depression
translation_zh: n. 勃鲁斯乐曲, (非正式)伤感的, 伤心的；[医] 忧闷, 沮丧
example: 这个忧郁布鲁斯歌曲为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. power to direct or determine; n. a relation of constraint of one entity (thing or person or group) by another; n. (physiology) regulation or maintenance of a function or action or reflex etc; n. the activity of managing or exerting control over something
translation_zh: n. 控制, 管理, 克制, 控制器, 操纵装置；vt. 控制, 操纵, 抑制；[计] 控制; 控制器
example: He can control his emotions.

meaning: a. marked by or capable of arousing controversy
translation_zh: a. 争论的, 论争的, 被议论的
example: A controversial plan to build a new road has met with protests.

meaning: v. make known; pass on, of information; v. transfer to another; v. transmit a title or property
translation_zh: vt. 传达, 运输, 转让；[经] 转让(财产等), 搬运
example: We need to convey this carefully.

meaning: v make (someone) agree, understand, or realize the truth or validity of something
translation_zh: vt. 说服, 使相信；[法] 使确信, 使信服, 使人认识错误
example: I tried to convince him to join us.

meaning: n. a document granting exclusive right to publish and sell literary or musical or artistic work; v. secure a copyright on a written work
translation_zh: n. 版权, 著作权；[法] 著作权
example: Copyright expires seventy years after the death of the author.

meaning: n. a county of southern England on the English Channel; n. British breed of hornless dark-faced domestic sheep
translation_zh: n. 汉普郡（英国南部之一郡）
example: 这个hampshire（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of offering an improvement to replace a mistake; setting right; n. a quantity that is added or subtracted in order to increase the accuracy of a scientific measure; n. something substituted for an error; n. a rebuke for making a mistake
translation_zh: n. 订正, 改正, 改正的地方；[化] 校正
example: Please make the necessary corrections.

meaning: n. soft silky fibers from cotton plants in their raw state; n. fabric woven from cotton fibers; n. erect bushy mallow plant or small tree bearing bolls containing seeds with many long hairy fibers; n. thread made of cotton fibers
translation_zh: n. 棉花；vi. 和谐, 有好感, 理解
example: From the age of six she worked in the fields, picking cotton.

meaning: n a telegram sent abroad; n a conductor for transmitting electrical or optical signals or electric power; n a very strong thick rope made of twisted hemp or steel wire; n a nautical unit of depth; n television that is transmitted over cable directly to the receiver; n a television system that transmits over cables; v send cables, wires, or telegrams; v fasten with a cable
translation_zh: n. 电缆；连线；锚索（cable的复数）
example: 这个(船只、桥梁等上的)巨缆为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n something that provides direction or advice as to a decision or course of action; v give advice to
translation_zh: n. 咨询服务
example: The counseling was important for everyone.

meaning: n something that provides direction or advice as to a decision or course of action; v give advice to
translation_zh: [法] 评议, 商议, 指导
example: The counselling was important for everyone.

meaning: bluetooth
translation_zh: n. 蓝牙技术（一种无线通信的标准）
example: 这个bluetooth（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the total number counted; n. the act of counting; reciting numbers in ascending order; n. a nobleman (in various countries) having rank equal to a British earl; v. determine the number or amount of
translation_zh: vt. 计算, 视为；vi. 计数；n. 计算, 合计, 计数, 伯爵；[计] 计数
example: Can you count to ten.

meaning: a. restrained or managed or kept within certain bounds
translation_zh: a. 受约束的, 克制的；[法] 受管制的, 受控制的, 受管辖的
example: 这个受约束的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. too numerous to be counted
translation_zh: a. 数不尽的, 无数的
example: This is a very countless situation.

meaning: n. (United Kingdom) a region created by territorial division for the purpose of local government; n. (United States) the largest administrative district within a state
translation_zh: n. 县, 郡
example: They live in the next county over.

meaning: n the organization that is the governing authority of a political unit; n the power or right to give orders or make decisions; n (usually plural) persons who exercise (administrative) control over others; n an expert whose views are taken as definitive; n freedom from doubt; belief in yourself and your abilities; n an administrative unit of government; n official permission or approval; n an authoritative written work
translation_zh: n. 当局, 官方（authority的复数）
example: 这个专家为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a quality of spirit that enables you to face danger or pain without showing fear
translation_zh: n. 勇气, 胆量
example: It takes courage to speak in front of a large audience.

meaning: a possessing or displaying courage; able to face and deal with danger or fear without flinching
translation_zh: a. 勇敢的, 大胆的, 有胆量的
example: I hope people will be courageous enough to speak out against this injustice.

meaning: n marrow squash plant whose fruit are eaten when small; n small cucumber-shaped vegetable marrow; typically dark green
translation_zh: n. 一种密生西葫芦
example: The courgette was important for everyone.

meaning: v cause to die; put to death, usually intentionally or knowingly; v thwart the passage of; v end or extinguish by forceful means; v be fatal; v be the source of great pain for; v overwhelm with hilarity, pleasure, or admiration; v hit with so much force as to make a return impossible, in racket games; v hit with great force; v deprive of life; v cause the death of, without intention; v drink down entirely; v mark for deletion, rub off, or erase; v tire out completely; v cause to cease operating; v destroy a vitally essential quality of or in

meaning: n. an assembly (including one or more judges) to conduct judicial business; n. a room in which a lawcourt sits; n. the sovereign and his advisers who are the governing power of a state; n. a specially marked horizontal area within which a game is played
translation_zh: n. 法院, 庭院, 奉承；vt. 献殷勤, 追求, 招致；vi. 求爱
example: The case went to court.

meaning: n. a vehicle designed for navigation in or on water or air or through outer space; n. people who perform a particular kind of skilled work; n. skill in an occupation or trade; n. shrewdness as demonstrated by being skilled in deception
translation_zh: n. 技艺, 手艺, 诡计；vt. 精心制作
example: She enjoys various arts and crafts.

meaning: n. a serious accident (usually involving one or more vehicles); n. a sudden large decline of business or the prices of stocks (especially one that causes additional failures); n. the act of colliding with something; n. (computer science) an event that causes a computer system to become inoperative
translation_zh: n. 哗啦声, 猛撞, 崩溃, 粗布；v. 撞碎, 破碎, (使)...坠毁；a. 速成的；[计] 崩溃
example: The car crashed into a tree.

meaning: v. bring into existence; v. pursue a creative activity; be engaged in a creative activity; v. invest with a new title, office, or rank; v. create by artistic means
translation_zh: vt. 创造, 建造, 引起, 任命
example: Artists create beautiful works of art.

meaning: n. a person who represents others; n. an advocate who represents someone else's policy or purpose; n. a member of the United States House of Representatives
translation_zh: n. 代表( representative的复数形式 ); 代理人; 典型人物; [常作 R-]（美国）众议院议员
example: 这个代表代理人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the human act of creating; n. an artifact that has been brought into existence by someone; n. the event that occurred at the beginning of something; n. (theology) God's act of bringing the universe into existence
translation_zh: n. 创造, 创作物, 发明；[化] 产生
example: The creation of new jobs is essential for the economy.

meaning: a. having the ability or power to create; s. promoting construction or creation
translation_zh: a. 有创造力的, 创作的, 产生的
example: She is a very creative artist.

translation_zh: n. 怀孕；丰富, 多产；意义深长
example: 这个怀孕为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who grows or makes or invents things
translation_zh: n. 上帝, 创造者, 创作者
example: He is the creator of this popular video game.

meaning: n events that provide the generative force that is the origin of something; n a justification for something existing or happening; n a series of actions advancing a principle or tending toward a particular end; n any entity that produces an effect or is responsible for events or results; n a comprehensive term for any proceeding in a court of law whereby an individual seeks a legal remedy; v give rise to; cause to happen or occur, not always intentionally; v cause to do; cause to act in a specified manner
translation_zh: n. 原因
example: 这个原因为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

translation_zh: n. 信用, 信任, 荣誉, 贷款, 学分；vt. 归功于, 赞颂, 信任, 相信；[计] 信用量
example: I paid with my credit card.

meaning: n. a state in south central United States; one of the Confederate states during the American Civil War; n. a river that rises in the Rocky Mountains in Colorado and flows southeast through Kansas and Oklahoma and through Arkansas to become a tributary of the Mississippi River
translation_zh: n. 阿肯色州
example: 这个arkansas（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the men and women who man a vehicle (ship, aircraft, etc.); n. the team of men manning a racing shell; v. serve as a crew member on
translation_zh: n. 全体人员, 一群人, 全体队员；crow的过去式
example: The airplane crew was very helpful.

meaning: n. (criminal law) an act punishable by law; usually considered an evil act; n. an evil act not necessarily punishable by law
translation_zh: n. 犯罪, 罪行, 罪恶；[法] 犯罪, 罪, 罪恶
example: The police are investigating the crime.

meaning: n. a person who is professionally engaged in the analysis and interpretation of works of art; n. anyone who expresses a reasoned judgment of something; n. someone who frequently finds fault or makes harsh and unfair judgments
translation_zh: n. 批评家, 鉴定家
example: Bradley Cooper's gripping performance has been praised by critics.

meaning: n. the force by which one object attracts another; n. an entertainment that is offered to the public; n. the quality of arousing interest; being attractive or something that attracts
translation_zh: n. 吸引( attraction的复数形式 ); 具有吸引力的事物; 有吸引力的特征（或品质、人）; （尤指两性间的）爱慕

meaning: n. the yield from plants in a single growing season; n. a cultivated plant that is grown commercially on a large scale; n. a collection of people or things appearing together; n. the output of something in a season

example: She gave a little crow of triumph.

translation_zh: a. 残酷的, 令人极痛苦的；[法] 残忍的, 残酷的
example: It was cruel to leave the dog alone in the rain.

translation_zh: n. 压碎, 粉碎, 群众, 迷恋；vt. 压破, 征服, 塞, 弄皱, 榨出；vi. 被压碎, 起皱, 挤
example: He accidentally crushed the empty can.

translation_zh: n. 文化, 修养, 耕种；vt. 耕种, 培养

example: The water cycle is an important natural process.

translation_zh: n. 雏菊, 一流人物；a. 第一流的

translation_zh: vt. 使茫然, 使发昏, 使眼花缭乱；n. 迷乱, 眼花缭乱

translation_zh: v. (使)眼花, 炫耀；n. 耀眼
example: He was momentarily dazzled by the strong sunlight.

translation_zh: n. 最后期限, 截止期限；[经] 截止日期
