translation_zh: n. 长条, 条状, 带, 脱衣舞；vt. 脱衣, 被剥去, 剥夺, 拆卸；vi. 脱衣服
example: She cut the fabric into long strips.

meaning: n. a piece of braid, usually on the sleeve, indicating military rank or length of service; n. a kind or category; n. a narrow marking of a different color or texture from the background; v. mark with stripes
translation_zh: n. 斑纹, 条纹；[医] 纹, 条纹
example: 这个条纹为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an energetic attempt to achieve something; n. strenuous effort; v. to exert strenuous effort against opposition
translation_zh: n. 斗争, 努力, 奋斗；vi. 努力, 奋斗, 挣扎
example: 这个挣扎为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. tenaciously unwilling or marked by tenacious unwillingness to yield
translation_zh: a. 顽固的, 不听话的, 执拗的, 棘手的
example: He was too stubborn to admit he was wrong.

meaning: a. caught or fixed; s. baffled
translation_zh: stick的过去式和过去分词
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常刺(stick 的过去式及过去分词)adj.动不了的的解释。

meaning: n. workplace for the teaching or practice of an art; n. workplace consisting of a room or building where movies or television shows or radio programs are produced and recorded
translation_zh: n. 工作室, 画室, 演播室, 电影制片厂
example: The artist works in a large studio.

meaning: s. filled with something; s. crammed with food
translation_zh: 已经喂饱了的；塞满了的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常充满的的解释。

meaning: v. walk unsteadily; v. miss a step and fall or nearly fall; v. encounter by chance; v. make an error
translation_zh: n. 绊倒, 蹒跚而行, 失足；vt. 使绊倒, 使困惑；vi. 绊倒, 失足, 失策, 犯错, 蹒跚, 踌躇
example: He stumbled over a loose rock and almost fell.

meaning: v. make senseless or dizzy by or as if by a blow; v. overcome as with astonishment or disbelief
translation_zh: vt. 使昏迷, 使震惊, 打昏；n. 昏迷, 猛击
example: 我们需要逐步stun这个方案。

meaning: s. causing great astonishment and consternation; s. causing or capable of causing bewilderment or shock or insensibility; s. strikingly beautiful or attractive
translation_zh: a. 打昏迷的, 弄得人昏头昏脑的, 令人震惊的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常极好的的解释。

meaning: n. a person who is not very bright; a. lacking or marked by lack of intellectual acuity
translation_zh: a. 愚蠢的, 麻木的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常愚蠢的的解释。

meaning: a. having elegance or taste or refinement in manners or dress
translation_zh: a. 现代风格的, 流行的, 潇洒的
example: She always wears very stylish clothes.

meaning: s. just below the level of consciousness
translation_zh: n. 潜在意识, 下意识；a. 下意识的, 潜意识的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常潜在意识的解释。

meaning: n. a submersible warship usually armed with torpedoes; v. move forward or under in a sliding motion; v. throw with an underhand motion; v. bring down with a blow to the legs
translation_zh: n. 潜水艇, 海底生物；a. 海中的, 生长在海中的；vt. 用潜水艇攻击；vi. 在下疾行, 在下滑动
example: The submarine can stay submerged for weeks.

meaning: s. having a firm basis in reality and being therefore important, meaningful, or considerable; a. having substance or capable of being treated as fact; not imaginary
translation_zh: n. 重要材料(或事物), 有实际价值的东西；a. 实质上的, 物质的, 有内容的, 结实的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常坚固的的解释。

meaning: n. a person or thing that takes or can take the place of another; n. an athlete who plays only when a starter on the team is replaced; v. put in the place of another; switch seemingly equivalent items; v. be a substitute
translation_zh: n. 代理, 代理人, 代用品, 代替者, 代替物；vt. 代替；vi. 替代, 取代, 代用；a. 代替的, 代用的, 代用品的；[计] 置换; 替代
example: 这个替代品为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. happening unexpectedly
translation_zh: adv. 突然, 意外, 忽然, 迅速, 即席作成, 即刻, 急速
example: 他意外地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. undergo or be subjected to; v. undergo (as of injuries and illnesses); v. experience (emotional) pain; v. get worse
translation_zh: vt. 遭受, 经历, 忍受；vi. 受痛苦, 受损害
example: He suffers from severe headaches.

meaning: a. of a quantity that can fulfill a need or requirement but without being abundant
translation_zh: a. 充分的, 足够的；[法] 充分的, 足够的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常足够的的解释。

meaning: n. an affix that is added at the end of the word; v. attach a suffix to
translation_zh: n. 后缀, 下标；vt. 添后缀；[计] 后缀
example: 这个添后缀为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of killing yourself; n. a person who kills himself intentionally
translation_zh: n. 自杀, 自杀者；v. 自杀；a. 自杀的
example: 这个自杀为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a meeting of heads of governments; v. reach the summit (of a mountain)
translation_zh: n. 顶点, 最高阶层, 最高级会议；a. 政府首脑的, 最高级的
example: 这个（政府间的）首脑会议为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v expose one's body to the sun
translation_zh: n. 日光浴
example: She loves to sunbathe on the beach during her holidays.

meaning: n. timepiece that indicates the daylight hours by the shadow that the gnomon casts on a calibrated dial
translation_zh: n. 日规, 日晷
example: 这个日晷为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. atmospheric phenomena accompanying the daily appearance of the sun; n. the daily event of the sun rising above the horizon; s. of an industry or technology; new and developing
translation_zh: n. 日出, 黎明, 拂晓
example: 这个日出（时分）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the time in the evening at which the sun begins to fall below the horizon; n. atmospheric phenomena accompanying the daily disappearance of the sun; n. the daily event of the sun sinking below the horizon; s. of a declining industry or technology
translation_zh: n. 日落, 晚年
example: 这个日落（时）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. one of greater rank or station or quality; n. the head of a religious community; n. a town in northwest Wisconsin on Lake Superior across from Duluth; a. of high or superior quality or performance
translation_zh: n. 长者, 占优势的人, 上级；a. 上级的, 出众的, 高傲的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常上级的的解释。

meaning: n. an irrational belief arising from ignorance or fear
translation_zh: n. 迷信；[法] 迷信
example: 这个迷信 (n.) - 相信非科学的东西为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an amount of something available for use; n. offering goods and services for sale; v. give something useful or necessary to
translation_zh: n. 补给, 供给, 供应品；vt. 补给, 供给, 提供, 补充；vi. 替代
example: The supply of fresh water is limited.

meaning: n. a person who backs a politician or a team etc.
translation_zh: n. 支持者, 后盾, 迫随者, 护身织物；[法] 支持者, 赡养者, 抚养者
example: She is a strong supporter of environmental protection.

meaning: a. furnishing support or assistance
translation_zh: a. 支撑, 支承, 资助, 赞助, 支援, 经受, 忍受, 扶养, 证实, 鼓励, 维持, 伴奏
example: My family has always been very supportive of my decisions.

meaning: v. express a supposition
translation_zh: vt. 推想, 假设, 以为, 想像, 假定；vi. 料想
example: I suppose you're right.

meaning: r believed or reputed to be the case
translation_zh: adv. 想象上, 看上去像, 被认为是, 恐怕, 按照推测
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r. definitely or positively (`sure' is sometimes used informally for `surely')
translation_zh: adv. 的确地, 安全地；[经] 保证, 保证人, 保证金
example: Surely you're not going out in this rain?

meaning: n. the outer boundary of an artifact or a material layer constituting or resembling such a boundary; n. the extended two-dimensional outer boundary of a three-dimensional object; n. the outermost level of the land or sea; n. a superficial aspect as opposed to the real nature of something
translation_zh: n. 面, 表面, 水面, 外表, 平面；a. 表面的, 外观的, 肤浅的, 水面上的；vt. 使成平面, 使浮出水面；vi. 浮出水面, 呈现, 在地面上工作
example: The table has a smooth surface.

meaning: n. a physician who specializes in surgery
translation_zh: n. 外科医生, 军医, 船医；[医] 外科医师
example: The surgeon explained the procedure carefully.

meaning: n. the branch of medical science that treats disease or injury by operative procedures; n. a room where a doctor or dentist can be consulted
translation_zh: n. 外科, 手术, 手术室, 换球术
example: 这个外科学为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in a surprising manner
translation_zh: adv. 使人惊奇, 出人意外, 惊人, 令人惊讶
example: Surprisingly, the weather was good today.

meaning: v. extend on all sides of simultaneously; encircle
translation_zh: vt. 包围, 环绕, 围绕；n. 围绕物
example: Trees surround the old house.

meaning: v extend on all sides of simultaneously; encircle; v envelop completely; v surround so as to force to give up; v surround with a wall in order to fortify; s closely encircling
translation_zh: n. 环境；a. 周围的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常环境的解释。

meaning: n. a state of surviving; remaining alive; n. a natural process resulting in the evolution of organisms best adapted to the environment; n. something that survives
translation_zh: n. 生存, 残存, 幸存者；a. 赖以生存的
example: 这个幸存为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. one who lives through affliction; n. one who outlives another; n. an animal that survives in spite of adversity
translation_zh: n. 生还者, 幸存者；[法] 生还者, 生存者, 辛存者
example: She was the sole survivor of the accident.

meaning: n. someone who is under suspicion; v. imagine to be the case or true or probable; v. hold in suspicion; believe to be guilty
translation_zh: n. 被怀疑者, 嫌疑犯；a. 令人怀疑的, 不可信的, 可疑的；v. 怀疑, 猜想
example: 这个猜想为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the state of being suspected; n. being of a suspicious nature
translation_zh: n. 怀疑, 觉察, 嫌疑；[法] 怀疑, 疑心, 嫌疑
example: 这个怀疑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a group of many things in the air or on the ground
translation_zh: n. 群, 大群, 蜂群, 分蜂群；vi. 分群, 群集, 聚集一块, 云集, 攀；vt. 挤满, 爬, 攀
example: 这个一大群（移动中的昆虫）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. promise solemnly; take an oath; v. make a deposition; declare under oath
translation_zh: vt. 发誓, 咒骂, 使宣誓；vi. 发誓, 诅咒；n. 诅咒, 誓言
example: I swear I will tell the truth.

meaning: n. condensation of moisture on a cold surface; v. excrete perspiration through the pores in the skin
translation_zh: n. 汗, 汗水, 水珠, 焦急；vi. 出汗, 渗出, 冒出水气, 结水珠, 烦恼, 懊恼；vt. 使出汗, 流出, 榨出, 使汗流浃背
example: After running, he was covered in sweat.

meaning: n. cotton knit pullover with long sleeves worn during athletic activity
translation_zh: n. 园领长袖运动衫
example: 这个运动衫为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the undulating movement of the surface of the open sea; n. a rounded elevation (especially one on an ocean floor); n. a crescendo followed by a decrescendo; v. increase in size, magnitude, number, or intensity
translation_zh: n. 增大, 隆起的部分, 巨浪, 肿胀；a. 优秀的, 一流的；vi. 增大, 膨胀, 肿胀, 增强, 骄傲；vt. 使膨胀, 使增大, 使上涨, 使骄傲
example: 我们需要逐步swell这个方案。

meaning: n. a trained athlete who participates in swimming meets; n. a person who travels through the water by swimming
translation_zh: n. 游泳者
example: 这个游泳者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. control consisting of a mechanical or electrical or electronic device for making or breaking or changing the connections in a circuit; n. hairpiece consisting of a tress of false hair; used by women to give shape to a coiffure; n. railroad track having two movable rails and necessary connections; used to turn a train from one track to another or to store rolling stock; n. a flexible implement used as an instrument of punishment
translation_zh: n. 开关, 电闸, 转换, 软枝, 鞭子, 道岔；vt. 转变, 切换, 摆动, 转换, 使转轨；vi. 转换, 变换, 摆动；[计] 交换机；开关; 翻转; 转移
example: 这个转换为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v increase in size, magnitude, number, or intensity; v become filled with pride, arrogance, or anger; v expand abnormally; v come up (as of feelings and thoughts, or other ephemeral things); v come up, as of a liquid; v cause to become swollen; s characteristic of false pride; having an exaggerated sense of self-importance
translation_zh: a. 肿大的, 涨水的, 夸张的, 骄傲的；swell的过去分词
example: Her ankle was swollen after the fall.

meaning: n. a cutting or thrusting weapon that has a long metal blade and a hilt with a hand guard
translation_zh: n. 刀, 剑, 战争, 武力, 剑状物
example: The knight carried a shining sword.

meaning: n. an inclination to support or be loyal to or to agree with an opinion; n. sharing the feelings of others (especially feelings of sorrow or anguish); n. a relation of affinity or harmony between people; whatever affects one correspondingly affects the other
translation_zh: n. 同情, 赞同, 怜悯, 慰问, 吊唁；[医] 交感[作用], 同感[作用], 感应, 同情
example: I felt great sympathy for the victims.

meaning: n. (medicine) any sensation or change in bodily function that is experienced by a patient and is associated with a particular disease; n. anything that accompanies X and is regarded as an indication of X's existence
translation_zh: n. 症状, 征候, 征兆；[医] 症状
example: 这个（医） 症状为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a complex of concurrent things; n. a pattern of symptoms indicative of some disease
translation_zh: n. 并发症状, 综合征, 同时存在的事物；[计] 校验子; 并发位
example: 这个综合征为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. characterized by order and planning
translation_zh: a. 有系统的, 分类上的, 体系的；[医] 系统的, 系的, 分类的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常有系统的的解释。

meaning: n. a slab of stone or wood suitable for bearing an inscription; n. a small flat compressed cake of some substance
translation_zh: n. 平板, 门牌, 笔记簿, 碑, 匾, 药片；[化] 片剂
example: 这个碑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of photographing a scene or part of a scene without interruption; v. carry out; v. require (time or space); v. get into one's hands, take physically
translation_zh: vt. 拿, 取, 抓, 带领, 获得, 就座, 接受, 吃, 吸引, 采取, 乘, 需要, 花费；vi. 吃掉对方棋子, 抓住, 起作用, 依法获得财产；n. 拿, 取, 收成, 奏效
example: 这个带(去)为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a concession made by a labor union to a company that is trying to lower its expenditures; n. the act of taking the ball or puck away from the team on the offense (as by the interception of a pass)
translation_zh: a. 外吃的, 外卖的；n. 外卖食品的餐馆, 外卖食品的商店
example: Let's get a Chinese takeaway tonight.

meaning: n a message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program; n a trivial lie
translation_zh: n. 故事, 谎言, 谣言, 陈述, 叙述；[法] 虚语, 诽语, 谣言
example: The old man told a fascinating tale about his travels.

meaning: a. endowed with talent or talents
translation_zh: a. 天资高的, 有才能的
example: She is a very talented musician.

meaning: n. an exchange of ideas via conversation; n. discussion; (`talk about' is a less formal alternative for `discussion of'); n. the act of giving a talk to an audience; n. idle gossip or rumor
translation_zh: n. 谈话, 交谈, 会谈, 讲话, 演讲, 空谈, 谣言, 方言, 语言；vi. 讲话, 演讲, 说话, 谈话, 交流, 闲聊, 说闲话；vt. 讲, 说, 讨论, 谈论；[计] 对话类, 聊天
example: 这个说为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s full of trivial conversation; s unwisely talking too much; s friendly and open and willing to talk
translation_zh: a. 喜欢说话的, 饶舌的, 多嘴的
example: My little sister is very talkative, she never stops chatting.

meaning: n. an enclosed armored military vehicle; has a cannon and moves on caterpillar treads; n. a large (usually metallic) vessel for holding gases or liquids; n. as much as a tank will hold; v. store in a tank by causing (something) to flow into it
translation_zh: n. 槽, 箱, 柜, 罐, 池塘, 储水池, 坦克；vt. 储于箱中
example: 这个（存放液体或气体的）箱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the sensation that results when taste buds in the tongue and throat convey information about the chemical composition of a soluble stimulus; n. delicate discrimination (especially of aesthetic values); n. a brief experience of something; n. a small amount eaten or drunk
translation_zh: n. 味道, 品味, 味觉, 感受, 体验, 爱好, 审美, 少量；vt. 尝, 察觉...的味道, 体会；vi. 品尝, 察觉味道, 有某种味道
example: 这个味道为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. lacking flavor; a. lacking aesthetic or social taste
translation_zh: a. 没味道的, 无鉴赏力的
example: The soup was bland and tasteless.

meaning: a. pleasing to the sense of taste
translation_zh: a. 好吃的, 可口的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常美味的的解释。

meaning: n. charge against a citizen's person or property or activity for the support of government; v. levy a tax on; v. set or determine the amount of (a payment such as a fine); v. use to the limit
translation_zh: n. 税, 税款, 重负, 会费；vt. 课以税, 使负重荷, 斥责
example: You have to pay tax on that.

meaning: n. the profession of a teacher; n. a doctrine that is taught
translation_zh: n. 教学, 学说, 教导
example: 这个教学为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a fellow member of a team
translation_zh: n. 队友
example: My teammate scored the winning goal.

meaning: n. cooperative work done by a team (especially when it is effective)
translation_zh: n. 协同作业, 协力；[法] 联合工作, 联合行动, 协调工作
example: Teamwork is essential for the success of the project.

meaning: n. someone given to teasing (as by mocking or stirring curiosity); n. the act of harassing someone playfully or maliciously (especially by ridicule); provoking someone with persistent annoyances; v. annoy persistently; v. harass with persistent criticism or carping
translation_zh: n. 揶揄, 戏弄, 逗惹；vt. 戏弄, 取笑, 强求, 梳理, 使起毛
example: Don't tease your little brother.

meaning: n. a practical method or art applied to some particular task
translation_zh: n. 技巧, 技术, 方法；[化] 工艺方法; 技巧
example: 这个技巧为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. based in scientific and industrial progress
translation_zh: a. 技术的；[经] 工艺的, 技术的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常技术上的工艺(学)的由于技术原因的的解释。

meaning: n a juvenile between the onset of puberty and maturity; s being of the age 13 through 19
translation_zh: n. 愤怒, 悲哀
example: 这个青少年（等于teenager）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n (often plural) systems used in transmitting messages over a distance electronically; n (often plural) the branch of electrical engineering concerned with the technology of electronic communication at a distance
translation_zh: n. 电信, 通讯, 电信学；[电] 电通信
example: 这个通讯行业：服务类型变更为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a message transmitted by telegraph
translation_zh: n. 电报, 一封电报；[计] 电报
example: 这个电报vt.电报：用电报机发送的信息为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. United States physicist (born in Hungary) who worked on the first atom bomb and the first hydrogen bomb (1908-2003); n. an official appointed to count the votes (especially in legislative assembly); n. an employee of a bank who receives and pays out money
translation_zh: n. 叙述者, 讲故事者, 出纳员；[经] 出纳员
example: The bank teller helped me deposit my check.

meaning: n. a characteristic (habitual or relatively temporary) state of feeling; n. a disposition to exhibit uncontrolled anger; n. the elasticity and hardness of a metal object; its ability to absorb considerable energy before cracking; v. harden by reheating and cooling in oil
translation_zh: n. (钢等的)硬度, 脾气, 心情, 中和剂, 倾向, 回火；vt. 使回火, 锻炼, 调和, 使缓和；vi. 回火
example: He has a very short temper.

meaning: n a worker (especially in an office) hired on a temporary basis; a not permanent; not lasting; s lacking continuity or regularity
translation_zh: a. 暂时的, 临时的；n. 临时工, 临时雇员；[计] 临时
example: This is just a temporary solution.

meaning: v. dispose or incline or entice to; v. give rise to a desire by being attractive or inviting; v. try to seduce; v. try presumptuously
translation_zh: vt. 诱惑, 引诱, 引起...的兴趣, 吸引, 冒...风险
example: 我们需要逐步tempt这个方案。

meaning: v. have a tendency or disposition to do or be something; be inclined; v. have care of or look after; v. manage or run
translation_zh: vi. 走向, 有某种的倾向, 易于, 照顾, 注意；vt. 照料, 护理
example: Prices tend to rise in the summer.

meaning: n. a characteristic likelihood of or natural disposition toward a certain condition or character or effect; n. a general direction in which something tends to move
translation_zh: n. 趋向, 倾向；[医] 趋向, 趋势
example: 这个经常性行为为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a grammatical category of verbs used to express distinctions of time; v. increase the tension on; v. become tense, nervous, or uneasy; v. cause to be tense and uneasy or nervous or anxious
translation_zh: a. 紧张的, 拉紧的；v. (使)紧张, (使)拉紧；n. 时态
example: The atmosphere in the room was very tense.

meaning: n. (psychology) a state of mental or emotional strain or suspense; n. the physical condition of being stretched or strained; n. a balance between and interplay of opposing elements or tendencies (especially in art or literature); n. (physics) a stress that produces an elongation of an elastic physical body
translation_zh: n. 紧张, 不安, 拉紧, 张力, 压力, 电压；vt. 拉紧, 使紧张
example: 这个张力为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a portable shelter (usually of canvas stretched over supporting poles and fastened to the ground with ropes and pegs); n. a web that resembles a tent or carpet
translation_zh: n. 帐篷, 帷幕, 住处, 塞条, 塞子；vi. 住帐蓬, 宿营, 暂时居住；vt. 用帐篷遮盖, 使住帐篷, 用塞条嵌入
example: 这个帐篷为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a word or expression used for some particular thing; n. a limited period of time; n. any distinct quantity contained in a polynomial; n. one of the substantive phrases in a logical proposition
translation_zh: n. 术语, 专有名词, 期限, 学期, 任期, 条件, 价钱, 关系, 地位, 项, 界石；vt. 称, 呼；[计] 检索词; 项
example: The school term ends in July.

meaning: n. station where transport vehicles load or unload passengers or goods; n. a contact on an electrical device (such as a battery) at which electric current enters or leaves; n. electronic equipment consisting of a device providing access to a computer; has a keyboard and display; a. of or relating to or situated at the ends of a delivery route
translation_zh: n. 终端机, 终点, 末端, 极限, 终点站；a. 终点的, 定期的, 致死的, 结尾的, 末端的, 晚期的；[计] 终端; 终端设备
example: 这个终端机为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. used as intensifiers; r. in a terrible manner
translation_zh: adv. 可怕地, 甚为, 非常
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. very great or intense; s. causing extreme terror
translation_zh: a. 非常好的, 极端的, 可怕的
example: We had a terrific time at the party.

meaning: v fill with terror; frighten greatly; s thrown into a state of intense fear or desperation
translation_zh: a. 受惊吓的；感到恐惧的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常很害怕的的解释。

meaning: n. a person who inspires fear or dread; n. a very troublesome child; n. the use of extreme fear in order to coerce people (especially for political reasons)
translation_zh: n. 恐怖, 可怕的人；[医] 惊吓, 惊悸
example: 这个惊恐为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the calculated use of violence (or the threat of violence) against civilians in order to attain goals that are political or religious or ideological in nature; this is done through intimidation or coercion or instilling fear
translation_zh: n. 恐怖主义, 恐怖统治, 恐怖状态；[法] 胁迫, 暴政, 恐怖政治
example: 这个恐怖主义为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a feeling or showing gratitude
translation_zh: a. 感谢的, 感激的, 欣慰的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常感谢的的解释。

meaning: n the act of taking something from someone unlawfully
translation_zh: n. 盗窃, 失窃, 盗窃罪, 赃物；[法] 盗窃行为, 偷窃, 失窃
example: 这个偷盗为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a well-substantiated explanation of some aspect of the natural world; an organized system of accepted knowledge that applies in a variety of circumstances to explain a specific set of phenomena; n. a belief that can guide behavior
translation_zh: n. 理论, 学说, 原理, 意见, 推测；[化] 理论
example: 这个理论为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. painstakingly careful and accurate
translation_zh: a. 十分的, 彻底的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常彻底的的解释。

meaning: n. a warning that something unpleasant is imminent; n. declaration of an intention or a determination to inflict harm on another
translation_zh: n. 恐吓, 恶兆, 威胁；[经] 威胁
example: He received a death threat.

meaning: v pose a threat to; present a danger to; v to utter intentions of injury or punishment against:"He threatened me when I tried to call the police"; v to be a menacing indication of something:"The clouds threaten rain"; s threatening or foreshadowing evil or tragic developments; s darkened by clouds
translation_zh: a. 胁迫的, 危险的；[法] 威胁的, 恐吓的, 危险的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常胁迫的的解释。

meaning: n. a suspenseful adventure story or play or movie
translation_zh: n. 使人激动的东西, 使人毛骨悚然的东西, 使人毛骨悚然的小说
example: I love reading a good thriller before bed.

meaning: s. (of a route or journey etc.) continuing without requiring stops or changes; r. from beginning to end; r. over the whole distance; r. to completion
translation_zh: adv. 穿越, 从头至尾, 到底, 因为；prep. 经过, 穿过；a. 对穿的, 直达的, 完结的
example: 他通过地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r. from first to last
translation_zh: adv. 到处, 贯穿全部地, 自始至终；prep. 遍及, 在各处；[计] 吞吐量
example: 这个(表示时间)自始至终为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the thick short innermost digit of the forelimb; n. the part of a glove that provides a covering for the thumb
translation_zh: n. 拇指；vt. 以拇指拨弄, 笨拙地摆弄, 用拇指翻旧, 迅速翻阅, 作搭车手势
example: 这个以拇指拨弄为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a heavy dull sound (as made by impact of heavy objects); n. a heavy blow with the hand; v. hit hard with the hand, fist, or some heavy instrument
translation_zh: n. 重打, 重击声；v. 重打, 撞击, 痛打
example: His heart began to thump loudly in his chest.

meaning: n. a booming or crashing noise caused by air expanding along the path of a bolt of lightning; v. move fast, noisily, and heavily; v. utter words loudly and forcefully; v. be the case that thunder is being heard
translation_zh: n. 雷, 雷声；vi. 打雷, 轰隆地响, 怒喝；vt. 大声喊出, 轰隆地发出
example: 这个雷声为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. extremely ominous
translation_zh: a. 将要打雷的, 像打雷的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常像打雷的的解释。

meaning: r. in the way indicated; (`thusly' is a nonstandard variant)
translation_zh: adv. 如此, 因此, 到如此程度；[医] 乳香
example: 他于是地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a metallic tapping sound; n. any of two families of small parasitic arachnids with barbed proboscis; feed on blood of warm-blooded animals; n. a light mattress; v. make a sound like a clock or a timer
translation_zh: n. 滴答声, 一瞬间, 壁虱, 褥套, 信用, 赊欠；vi. 滴答响, 活动；vt. 滴答地记录, 标记号于
example: The clock began to tick loudly.

meaning: n. the periodic rise and fall of the sea level under the gravitational pull of the moon; n. something that may increase or decrease (like the tides of the sea); n. there are usually two high and two low tides each day; v. rise or move forward
translation_zh: n. 潮, 潮汐, 趋势, 潮流, 涨潮, 高潮；vt. 使随潮漂流；vi. 顺潮行驶
example: The tide is coming in, so the beach will get smaller.

meaning: v. make tight or tighter; v. become tight or tighter
translation_zh: vt. 勒紧, 使变紧；vi. 变紧, 绷紧
example: Please tighten the screws on this shelf.

meaning: r. in a tight or constricted manner; r. securely fixed or fastened
translation_zh: adv. 紧紧地, 坚固地
example: 他紧紧地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a flat thin rectangular slab (as of fired clay or rubber or linoleum) used to cover surfaces; n. a thin flat slab of fired clay used for roofing; n. game equipment consisting of a flat thin piece marked with characters and used in board games like Mah-Jong, Scrabble, etc.; v. cover with tiles
translation_zh: n. 砖瓦, 瓷砖, 瓦片；vt. 铺以瓦, 铺以瓷砖；[计] 平铺
example: The bathroom floor was covered with white tiles.

meaning: n. unstratified soil deposited by a glacier; consists of sand and clay and gravel and boulders mixed together; v. work land as by ploughing, harrowing, and manuring, in order to make it ready for cultivation
translation_zh: prep. 直到, 在...以前, 迄；conj. 直到...为止；vt. 耕种；n. 放钱的抽屉, 备用现金, 冰碛
example: 这个直到 conj. 直到...为止 n. [地理][水文] 冰碛为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. before a time limit expires; s. done or happening at the appropriate or proper time
translation_zh: a. 及时的, 适时的；adv. 及时地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常及时的的解释。

meaning: n. a silvery malleable metallic element that resists corrosion; used in many alloys and to coat other metals to prevent corrosion; obtained chiefly from cassiterite where it occurs as tin oxide; n. a vessel (box, can, pan, etc.) made of tinplate and used mainly in baking; v. plate with tin; v. prepare (a metal) for soldering or brazing by applying a thin layer of solder to the surface
translation_zh: n. 锡, 马口铁, 罐头；vt. 在...镀锡于；a. 锡制的；[计] tin阅读程序
example: He opened a tin of beans.

meaning: s very small
translation_zh: a. 很少的, 微小的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常极小的的解释。

meaning: n. hoop that covers a wheel; v. lose interest or become bored with something or somebody; v. exhaust or get tired through overuse or great strain or stress
translation_zh: n. 轮胎, 头饰；vt. 使疲倦, 使厌烦, 打扮；vi. 疲劳, 厌倦
example: 我们需要逐步tire这个方案。

meaning: v lose interest or become bored with something or somebody; v exhaust or get tired through overuse or great strain or stress; v deplete; v cause to be bored; s producing exhaustion
translation_zh: a. 引起疲劳的, 累人的；[医] 轮箍术(髌骨骨折时)
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常累人的的解释。

meaning: n. part of an organism consisting of an aggregate of cells having a similar structure and function; n. a soft thin (usually translucent) paper
translation_zh: n. 薄的织物, 薄纱, 棉纸, 组织, 一套；[化] 组织
example: Could you pass me a tissue, please?

meaning: n. leaves of the tobacco plant dried and prepared for smoking or ingestion; n. aromatic annual or perennial herbs and shrubs
translation_zh: n. 烟草, 香烟；[医] 烟草
example: Smoking tobacco is harmful to your health.

meaning: n. a mobile mass of muscular tissue covered with mucous membrane and located in the oral cavity; n. any long thin projection that is transient; n. a manner of speaking; n. the tongue of certain animals used as meat
translation_zh: n. 舌, 语言能力, 讲话方式, 语言；vt. 舔, 斥责, 发...的音；vi. 使用舌头, 吹管乐器
example: 这个语言为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a dentifrice in the form of a paste
translation_zh: n. 牙膏；[化] 牙膏
example: 这个牙膏为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the upper part of anything; n. the highest or uppermost side of anything; n. the first half of an inning; while the visiting team is at bat; n. the greatest possible intensity
translation_zh: n. 顶部, 顶端, 极点, 上面, 上部, 顶篷, 最高地位, 首位, 陀螺；a. 最高的, 顶上的, 头等的；vt. 盖, 加以顶, 高达, 超越；vi. 结束, 达到顶点, 高出；[计] TOP协议
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常顶的解释。

meaning: n. a localized and violently destructive windstorm occurring over land characterized by a funnel-shaped cloud extending toward the ground
translation_zh: n. 旋风, 龙卷风, 大雷雨
example: The tornado caused widespread damage.

meaning: n. an abrupt movement; v. agitate
translation_zh: n. 投掷, 抛, 摇摆, 震荡, 掷钱币决定；vt. 投掷, 猛抬, 摇荡, 使不安, 掷钱币决定；vi. 被到处扔, 摇摆, 颠簸, 辗转, 掷钱币决定某事
example: It was a coin toss to decide who started.

meaning: v. add up in number or quantity; v. determine the sum of; v. damage beyond the point of repair
translation_zh: a. 全体的, 总的, 全然的；vt. 计算...的总和, 共计为；vi. 合计；n. 总数, 全体, 合计；adv. 统统
example: The total cost of the trip was higher than expected.

meaning: r to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly')
translation_zh: adv. 完全地
example: I totally agree with you.

meaning: n. the business of providing services to tourists
translation_zh: n. 观光业, 游览；[经] 旅游业
example: Tourism is a major industry in this region.

meaning: n. a sporting competition in which contestants play a series of games to decide the winner; n. a series of jousts between knights contesting for a prize
translation_zh: n. 比赛, 竞赛, 锦标赛, 联赛
example: Our team won the football tournament last year.

meaning: n. a just detectable amount; n. an indication that something has been present; n. either of two lines that connect a horse's harness to a wagon or other vehicle or to a whiffletree; n. a visible mark (as a footprint) left by the passage of person or animal or vehicle
translation_zh: n. 痕迹, 踪迹, 微量, 迹线, 缰绳；vt. 追踪, 回溯, 描绘；vi. 追溯, 沿路走
example: 这个查出为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: tracksuit
translation_zh: n. 运动服
example: 这个tracksuit（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. according to tradition; in a traditional manner
translation_zh: adv. 传统上；传说上；习惯上
example: Traditionally, we have turkey for Christmas.

meaning: n. drama in which the protagonist is overcome by some superior force or circumstance; excites terror or pity
translation_zh: n. 悲剧, 惨案, 悲剧作品；[法] 惨事, 灾难, 不辛
example: 这个悲惨事件为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. very sad; especially involving grief or death or destruction; a. of or relating to or characteristic of tragedy
translation_zh: a. 悲惨的, 悲剧的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常悲剧的的解释。

meaning: n. a track or mark left by something that has passed; n. a path or track roughly blazed through wild or hilly country; v. move, proceed, or walk draggingly or slowly; v. hang down so as to drag along the ground
translation_zh: n. 踪迹, 痕迹, 一串, 尾部, 小径, 持枪姿势；vt. 拖, 尾随, 追踪, 落后于, 开出路；vi. 拖曳, 垂下, 落后, 飘出, 蔓生
example: We followed the hiking trail through the forest.

meaning: v. subject to a mathematical transformation; v. change or alter in form, appearance, or nature; v. change in outward structure or looks; v. convert (one form of energy) to another
translation_zh: vt. 使转换, 改变, 改造, 使...变形；vi. 改变, 转化, 变换；[计] 变换
example: 我们需要逐步transform这个方案。

meaning: n. a qualitative change; n. (mathematics) a function that changes the position or direction of the axes of a coordinate system; n. a rule describing the conversion of one syntactic structure into another related syntactic structure
translation_zh: n. 变形, 变质, 变化, 改革, 变换；[化] 转化; 变换
example: 这个变化为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. of or relating to or characterized by transition
translation_zh: a. 变迁的, 过渡期的；[医] 转变的, 过渡的; 过渡型单核白细胞
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常变迁的的解释。

meaning: v. restate (words) from one language into another language; v. change from one form or medium into another; v. bring to a certain spiritual state; v. change the position of (figures or bodies) in space without rotation
translation_zh: vt. 翻译, 解释, 转化, 转变为, 调动；vi. 翻译, 被译；[计] 转换
example: 我们需要逐步translate这个方案。

meaning: n. an exchange of molecules (and their kinetic energy and momentum) across the boundary between adjacent layers of a fluid or across cell membranes; v. move something or somebody around; usually over long distances; v. move while supporting, either in a vehicle or in one's hands or on one's body; v. transport commercially
translation_zh: n. 运输, 运输工具, 激动, 狂喜, 流放犯；vt. 传送, 运输, 流放；[计] 传送
example: Public transport is very efficient here.

meaning: n. the act of moving something from one location to another; n. the commercial enterprise of moving goods and materials
translation_zh: n. 运输, 输送, 交通车辆；[经] 运转, 运输, 运输费
example: Public transportation is very efficient here.

meaning: n. worthless people; v. dispose of (something useless or old)
translation_zh: n. 垃圾, 废物；vt. 丢弃
example: 这个垃圾为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an occurrence that causes special pleasure or delight; v. interact in a certain way; v. provide treatment for; v. provide with a gift or entertainment
translation_zh: n. 宴请, 款待；vt. 视为, 对待, 论述, 治疗, 款待；vi. 讨论, 谈判, 作东
example: Please treat others with respect.

meaning: n. care provided to improve a situation (especially medical procedures or applications that are intended to relieve illness or injury); n. the management of someone or something; n. a manner of dealing with something artistically
translation_zh: n. 治疗, 待遇, 处理；[医] 疗法, 治疗; 处理
example: He is receiving treatment for his illness.

meaning: n. a reflex motion caused by cold or fear or excitement; v. move or jerk quickly and involuntarily up and down or sideways
translation_zh: n. 战栗, 颤抖；vi. 战栗, 忧虑, 摇晃
example: His hands began to tremble from the cold and fear.

meaning: s extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree; that a whole civilization should be dependent on technology"- Walter Lippman; s extraordinarily good or great; used especially as intensifiers; s extreme in degree or extent or amount or impact
translation_zh: a. 巨大的, 非常的, 可怕的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常极大的的解释。

meaning: n a general direction in which something tends to move; n general line of orientation; n a general tendency to change (as of opinion); n the popular taste at a given time; v turn sharply; change direction abruptly
translation_zh: n. 趋势, 倾向, 走向；vi. 倾向, 转向；[计] 趋势
example: 这个趋势为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a device that activates or releases or causes something to happen; n. an act that sets in motion some course of events; v. release or pull the trigger on
translation_zh: n. 触发器, 扳机；vt. 触发, 发射, 引起；vi. 松开扳柄；[计] 切换开关
example: 这个触发为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a state of arrangement or appearance; n. attitude of an aircraft in flight when allowed to take its own orientation; n. cutting down to the desired size or shape; v. decorate, as with ornaments
translation_zh: n. 整齐, 情形, 修剪；a. 整齐的；vt. 使整齐, 整理, 修剪；vi. 调整, 见风使舵；[计] 库存管理检查规则程序
example: 这个修剪为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the exultation of victory
translation_zh: n. 凯旋, 胜利, 欢欣；vi. 得胜, 成功
example: 这个巨大成功为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator); a. of or relating to the tropics, or either tropic; s. characterized by or of the nature of a trope or tropes; changed from its literal sense; s. of weather or climate; hot and humid as in the tropics
translation_zh: a. 热带的, 热情的；[医] 热带的
example: Brazil has a tropical climate.

meaning: v. proclaim on, or as if on, a trumpet; v. play or blow on the trumpet; v. utter in trumpet-like sounds
translation_zh: n. 喇叭, 小号, 喇叭声；vi. 吹喇叭；vt. 用喇叭吹出, 吹嘘
example: 这个喇叭为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. worthy of trust or belief; s. taking responsibility for one's conduct and obligations
translation_zh: a. 可信赖的；[法] 可信任的, 可靠的, 可信赖的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常值得信赖的的解释。

meaning: n. an acrobatic feat of rolling or turning end over end; v. fall down, as if collapsing; v. roll over and over, back and forth; v. throw together in a confused mass
translation_zh: n. 跌倒, 摔跤, 翻斤斗；vi. 翻倒, 摔倒, 倒塌, 滚动, 翻斤斗, 仓促地行动；vt. 使摔倒, 使滚翻, 弄乱
example: The child began to tumble down the stairs.

meaning: n. tropical American prickly pear of Jamaica; n. important warm-water fatty fish of the genus Thunnus of the family Scombridae; usually served as steaks; n. any very large marine food and game fish of the genus Thunnus; related to mackerel; chiefly of warm waters; n. New Zealand eel
translation_zh: n. 金枪鱼, 金枪鱼肉
example: 这个<鱼>金枪鱼（科）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. unstable flow of a liquid or gas; n. instability in the atmosphere; n. a state of violent disturbance and disorder (as in politics or social conditions generally)
translation_zh: n. 混乱, 动荡, 骚乱, 紊流；[化] 湍流; 紊流
example: 这个骚动为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. act of changing in practice or custom; n. a shaving created when something is produced by turning it on a lathe; n. a movement in a new direction; n. the end-product created by shaping something on a lathe
translation_zh: n. 旋转, 转弯处, 车削工作；[化] 车削
example: 这个旋转为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any of various aquatic and land reptiles having a bony shell and flipper-like limbs for swimming; v. hunt for turtles, especially as an occupation
translation_zh: n. 海龟
example: 这个海龟为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. either of two offspring born at the same time from the same pregnancy; n. a waterfall in the Snake River in southern Idaho; v. duplicate or match; v. grow as twins
translation_zh: n. 双胞胎中一人, 一对非常相像的人(或物)中的一个；a. 双胞胎的, 成对的, 孪生的；vi. 生双胞胎, 成对；vt. 怀(双胞胎), 使成对
example: 这个孪生儿之一为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a jerky pulling movement; n. social dancing in which couples vigorously twist their hips and arms in time to the music; was popular in the 1960s; n. turning or twisting around (in place); v. turn in the opposite direction
translation_zh: n. 一扭, 扭曲, 曲折, 歪曲, 螺旋状, 新手法；vt. 拧, 扭, 捻, 编织, 使扭转, 缠绕, 盘绕, 歪曲, 使转动, 使苦恼, 使混乱, 使旋转；vi. 转向, 弯曲, 缠绕, 扭动, 呈螺旋形
example: The story had an unexpected twist at the end.

meaning: a. exhibiting the qualities or characteristics that identify a group or kind or category; s. conforming to a type
translation_zh: a. 典型的, 象征性的；[医] 典型的
example: It was a typical English summer day, cloudy and cool.

meaning: r. in a typical manner
translation_zh: adv. 代表性地；作为特色地
example: She typically arrives at work around 9 AM.

meaning: a. (usually followed by `to') not having the necessary means or skill or know-how; s. (usually followed by `to') lacking necessary physical or mental ability
translation_zh: a. 不能的, 不会的；[法] 无能力的, 无资格的, 没有办法的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不能的的解释。

meaning: a. oblivious of dangers or perils or calmly resolute in facing them
translation_zh: a. 不怕的
example: She was unafraid to speak her mind.

meaning: a beyond belief or understanding; s having a probability too low to inspire belief
translation_zh: a. 难以置信的
example: The story was absolutely unbelievable.

meaning: n. being unsettled or in doubt or dependent on chance
translation_zh: n. 不确定, 不可靠, 不确定的事物；[化] 不确定度
example: 这个无把握为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. not clear to the mind
translation_zh: a. 不易了解的, 不清楚的, 含混的
example: The instructions were unclear.

meaning: s. difficult to solve or alleviate; s. incapable of being controlled or managed
translation_zh: a. 无法控制的；[经] 不能控制的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无法控制的的解释。

meaning: v. make visible; v. remove all or part of one's clothes to show one's body
translation_zh: vt. 揭露, 揭开, 暴露, 脱帽致敬；vi. 脱帽致敬, 揭去盖子
example: They hope to uncover the truth.

meaning: s. dependent by virtue of youth
translation_zh: a. 未成年的, 未及法定年龄的；n. 缺乏, 不足
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常缺乏的解释。

meaning: v. pass through
translation_zh: vt. 遭受, 经历, 忍受；[法] 经受, 经历, 忍受
example: 我们需要逐步undergo这个方案。

meaning: n. an undergarment that covers the body from the waist no further than to the thighs; usually worn next to the skin
translation_zh: n. 衬裤, 短衬裤
example: 这个（男用）内裤为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. cancel, annul, or reverse an action or its effect; v. cause the ruin or downfall of
translation_zh: vt. 解开, 取消, 破坏, 毁灭, 扰乱；vi. 松开；[计] 撤消
example: I wish I could undo that mistake.

meaning: n. partial or complete nakedness; v. get undressed
translation_zh: vt. 使脱衣服, 暴露, 使卸去装饰；vi. 脱衣服
example: 我们需要逐步undress这个方案。

meaning: a. not engaged in a gainful occupation
translation_zh: a. 失业的, 未被利用的；[经] 没有被雇用的, 失业的, 没有被利用的
example: He has been unemployed for six months.

meaning: n. the state of being unemployed or not having a job
translation_zh: n. 失业, 失业人数；[经] 失业
example: 这个失业为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. not expected or anticipated
translation_zh: a. 料想不到的, 突然的, 意外的；[法] 不能预料的, 意外的
example: The sudden rain was completely unexpected.

meaning: r. in a way that was not expected
translation_zh: adv. 想不到的, 突然的, 意外的, 出乎意料的
example: The rain started unexpectedly.

meaning: r. in an unfair manner
translation_zh: adv. 不正当地；不公平地
example: He felt he was treated unfairly.

meaning: a. below the required standards for a purpose; a. not in good physical or mental condition; out of condition
translation_zh: a. 不适当的, 不胜任的, 不健康的；vt. 使不相宜, 使不合格
example: He was declared medically unfit for military service.

meaning: v. open to the view; v. extend or stretch out to a greater or the full length; v. spread out or open from a closed or folded state
translation_zh: vt. 展开, 打开, 披露, 开展, 挑明；vi. 伸展, 开花, 呈现
example: He watched the story unfold before his eyes.

meaning: n. a person who suffers misfortune; a. not favored by fortune; marked or accompanied by or resulting in ill fortune; s. unsuitable or regrettable
translation_zh: a. 不幸的, 不合适的, 不吉利的
example: It was an unfortunate accident, but no one was seriously hurt.

meaning: a. not easy to understand or use; a. not disposed to friendship or friendliness; s. not friendly
translation_zh: adv. 不友善地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不友好的的解释。

meaning: s. not necessarily inaudible but not heard
translation_zh: a. 没有被听到的, 未予倾听的, 未予考虑的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常没有听到的的解释。

meaning: v. become one
translation_zh: v. 统一, 使成一体
example: 我们需要逐步unify这个方案。

meaning: a. not having or showing interest; s. having no care or interest in knowing
translation_zh: a. 不感兴趣的, 无利害关系的
example: He seemed completely uninterested in the conversation.

meaning: a. arousing no interest or attention or curiosity or excitement; s. characteristic or suggestive of an institution especially in being uniform or dull or unimaginative
translation_zh: a. 引不起兴趣的, 无趣味的, 乏味的
example: The lecture was quite uninteresting, and I almost fell asleep.

meaning: n. an organization of employees formed to bargain with the employer; n. the United States (especially the northern states during the American Civil War); n. the state of being joined or united or linked; n. healing process involving the growing together of the edges of a wound or the growing together of broken bones
translation_zh: n. 联盟, 联合, 结合, 工会；[化] 联合; 联管节; 活接头
example: 这个同盟为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. (followed by `to') applying exclusively to a given category or condition or locality; s. highly unusual or rare but not the single instance
translation_zh: a. 独一无二的, 独特的, 稀罕的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常独一无二的的解释。

meaning: v. act in concert or unite in a common purpose or belief; v. have or possess in combination; v. bring together for a common purpose or action or ideology or in a shared situation; v. join or combine
translation_zh: vi. 联合, 接合, 混合；vt. 使联合, 统一, 使粘合, 使结合
example: The team needs to unite to win the championship.

meaning: n. everything that exists anywhere; n. everything stated or assumed in a given discussion
translation_zh: n. 宇宙, 星系, (思想等)范围
example: 这个宇宙为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: conj. Upon any less condition than (the fact or thing stated; in the sentence or clause which follows); if not; supposing that not;; if it be not; were it not that; except; as, we shall fail unless we are; industrious.
translation_zh: conj. 除非；prep. 除...之外
example: 这个除非为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. has little chance of being the case or coming about
translation_zh: a. 不太可能的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不太可能的的解释。

meaning: a. having or bringing misfortune
translation_zh: a. 不吉利的, 不祥的, 不幸的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不幸的的解释。

meaning: v. remove from its packing
translation_zh: vt. 从包裹中取出, 卸下, 打开；vi. 打开包裹；[计] 拆开
example: 我们需要逐步unpack这个方案。

meaning: a. not capable of being foretold; s. unknown in advance
translation_zh: a. 不可预知的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不可预言的事 adj. 不可预知的的解释。

meaning: a. lacking a logical or causal relation; a. not connected by kinship
translation_zh: [法] 无关的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无关的的解释。

meaning: a. not neat and tidy
translation_zh: a. 不整齐的, 懒散的, 混乱的
example: Her room was always untidy.

meaning: prep. To; unto; towards; -- used of material objects.; prep. To; up to; till; before; -- used of time; as, he staid; until evening; he will not come back until the end of the month.; conj. As far as; to the place or degree that; especially, up to; the time that; till. See Till, conj.
translation_zh: prep. 直到, 在...以前；conj. 直到...时, 在...以前
example: 这个到…为止为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. to a remarkable degree or extent
translation_zh: adv. 不寻常地, 异乎寻常地, (非正式)非常
example: 他非常地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. not wanted; not needed
translation_zh: a. 没人要的, 不需要的, 多余的
example: She received a lot of unwanted advice.

meaning: s somewhat ill or prone to illness
translation_zh: a. 不舒服的, 生病的, 身体不好的
example: She felt unwell after eating too much.

meaning: s. exalted emotionally especially with pride
translation_zh: a. 举起的, 上升的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常举起的解释。

meaning: v. transfer a file or program to a central computer from a smaller computer or a computer at a remote location
translation_zh: [计] 上装, 加载, 储入
example: Please upload the document to the shared drive.

meaning: n. piece of leather or synthetic material that forms the part of a shoe or boot above the sole that encases the foot; s. the topmost one of two; s. higher in place or position; s. superior in rank or accomplishment
translation_zh: a. 上面的, 较高的, 上级的, 上院的, 穿在外面的, 北部的, 地表的, 后期的；n. 鞋帮, 上齿
example: He lives on the upper floor of the building.

meaning: n. the part of a building above the ground floor; a. on or of upper floors of a building; r. on a floor above; r. with respect to the mind
translation_zh: a. 楼上的；adv. 在楼上, 向楼上, 处于更高地位；n. 楼层
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常楼上 adj. 楼上的 adv. 在楼上的解释。

meaning: s. directed up
translation_zh: a. 向上的；adv. 以上
example: He looked upward at the sky.

meaning: n. an instinctive motive; n. a strong restless desire; v. force or impel in an indicated direction
translation_zh: n. 冲动, 推动力, 迫切的要求；vt. 驱策, 力劝, 竭力主张, 推动；vi. 强烈要求
example: I urge you to reconsider your decision.

meaning: s compelling immediate action
translation_zh: a. 紧急的, 急迫的, 催逼的；[经] 紧急的, 急迫的
example: This is an urgent matter that needs our attention.

meaning: n. the customary manner in which a language (or a form of a language) is spoken or written
translation_zh: n. 用法, 使用, 习惯, 惯用法, 习惯法；[经] 使用情况, 使用用途, 惯例
example: 这个使用为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. having no beneficial use or incapable of functioning usefully
translation_zh: a. 无用的, 无效的, 无益的；[机] 无用, 无价值, 无效
example: This broken tool is completely useless.

meaning: n. being unoccupied
translation_zh: n. 空, 空白, 空缺, 空虚, 空闲；[化] 空位
example: There is a job vacancy in the marketing department.

meaning: s not clearly understood or expressed; a not precisely limited, determined, or distinguished; s lacking clarity or distinctness
translation_zh: a. 含糊的, 不清楚的, 茫然的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不明确的的解释。

meaning: s characteristic of false pride; having an exaggerated sense of self-importance; s unproductive of success
translation_zh: a. 无价值的, 徒然的, 空虚的, 自负的, 愚蠢的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常徒劳的的解释。

meaning: n. something of value; a. having great material or monetary value especially for use or exchange; s. having worth or merit or value
translation_zh: a. 有价值的, 贵重的, 宝贵的, 可估价的；[经] 有价值的, 可估价的, 贵重的
example: This old book is very valuable.

meaning: n. (Great Britain) a closed railroad car that carries baggage or freight; n. a camper equipped with living quarters; n. a truck with an enclosed cargo space
translation_zh: n. 货车, 篷车, 先锋, 前驱, 前卫；vt. 用货车搬运；[计] 增值网
example: 这个先锋为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (biology) a taxonomic category consisting of members of a species that differ from others of the same species in minor but heritable characteristics; n. a difference that is usually pleasant
translation_zh: n. 多样, 种类, 变种, 杂耍；[化] 变种
example: The store offers a wide variety of products.

meaning: s of many different kinds purposefully arranged but lacking any uniformity; s considered individually; s distinctly dissimilar or unlike; s having great diversity or variety
translation_zh: a. 不同的, 各种的, 多方面的, 许多的, 个别的, 杂色的；[法] 不同的, 种种的, 各式各样的
example: There are various options available.

meaning: v. be subject to change in accordance with a variable; v. make something more diverse and varied
translation_zh: vt. 改变, 使多样化；vi. 变化, 有不同, 违反
example: Prices may vary depending on the season.

meaning: s unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
translation_zh: a. 巨大的, 广大的, 非常的, 大量的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常巨大的的解释。

meaning: n. eater of fruits and grains and nuts; someone who eats no meat or fish or (often) any animal products
translation_zh: n. 素食者, 食草动物；a. 素食的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常素食者的解释。

meaning: n. a conveyance that transports people or objects; n. a medium for the expression or achievement of something; n. any substance that facilitates the use of a drug or pigment or other material that is mixed with it
translation_zh: n. 交通工具, 车辆, 传播媒介；[化] 载体; 运载体; 漆料
example: A car is a type of vehicle.

meaning: n. a blood vessel that carries blood from the capillaries toward the heart; n. a distinctive style or manner; n. any of the vascular bundles or ribs that form the branching framework of conducting and supporting tissues in a leaf or other plant organ; n. a layer of ore between layers of rock
translation_zh: n. 血管, 静脉, 纹理, 气质, 情绪；vt. 使有脉络, 像脉络般分布于
example: 这个静脉为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a tube in which a body fluid circulates; n. a craft designed for water transportation; n. an object used as a container (especially for liquids)
translation_zh: n. 船, 容器, 脉管；[医] 管, 脉管, (容)器
example: 这个船为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. work as a veterinarian; v. examine carefully; v. provide (a person) with medical care; v. provide veterinary care for
translation_zh: n. 兽医；vi. 当兽医；vt. 诊断, 检审
example: 这个审查（某人过去的记录、资格等）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. A road way.; prep. By the way of; as, to send a letter via Queenstown to; London.
translation_zh: prep. 经由, 经过, 通过；[医] 病毒灭活剂
example: 这个经由为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a specific form of evildoing
translation_zh: n. 恶习, 恶行, 罪恶, 堕落, 缺陷, 恶癖, 老虎钳；vt. 钳住；prep. 代替
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常堕落的解释。

meaning: n. an unfortunate person who suffers from some adverse circumstance; n. a person who is tricked or swindled
translation_zh: n. 受害人, 牺牲者, 牺牲品；[法] 受害人, 被害人, 遭难者
example: The police are helping the victims of the flood.

meaning: n. a successful ending of a struggle or contest
translation_zh: n. 胜利, 战胜, 克服
example: The team celebrated their victory.

meaning: n a mental position from which things are viewed; n a place from which something can be viewed
translation_zh: n. 观点
example: 这个观点为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an act of aggression (as one against a person who resists); n. a turbulent state resulting in injuries and destruction etc.
translation_zh: n. 猛烈, 暴力, 暴虐, 暴行；[法] 暴行, 暴力, 暴乱
example: 这个暴力为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in a violent manner
translation_zh: adv. 猛烈地, 激烈地, 极端地
example: The storm raged violently through the night.

meaning: s. being actually such in almost every respect; s. existing in essence or effect though not in actual fact
translation_zh: a. 实际上起作用的, 虚的, 实质的, 有效的, 事实上生效的；[计] 虚拟
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常实质上的的解释。

meaning: n. (virology) ultramicroscopic infectious agent that replicates itself only within cells of living hosts; many are pathogenic; a piece of nucleic acid (DNA or RNA) wrapped in a thin coat of protein; n. a harmful or corrupting agency; n. a software program capable of reproducing itself and usually capable of causing great harm to files or other programs on the same computer
translation_zh: n. 病毒, 滤过性病毒, 毒害；[化] 病毒
example: The doctor said it was a common cold virus.

meaning: n. an endorsement made in a passport that allows the bearer to enter the country issuing it; v. provide (a passport) with a visa; v. approve officially
translation_zh: n. 签证；vt. 签发
example: You need a visa to enter that country.

meaning: a. capable of being seen; or open to easy view; s. obvious to the eye; s. present and easily available
translation_zh: a. 看得见的, 明显的, 显然的；n. 可见物
example: The moon was clearly visible tonight.

meaning: n. a vivid mental image; n. the perceptual experience of seeing; n. a religious or mystical experience of a supernatural appearance
translation_zh: n. 视觉, 眼光, 视力, 幻想；vt. 梦见, 想象, 显示
example: 这个视力为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a relating to or using sight; s visible; give me the ocular proof"- Shakespeare
translation_zh: a. 视觉的；[医] 视觉的, 视力的, 视觉性记忆优势者
example: The artist created a stunning visual display.

meaning: r. with respect to vision
translation_zh: adv. 看, 视力, 视觉, 可见, 凭视力, 看到, 看得见, 光学, 形象化, 栩栩如生
example: 他视觉上地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. having the clarity and freshness of immediate experience
translation_zh: a. 生动的, 鲜明的, 鲜艳的, 活泼的, 逼真的, 清晰的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常生动的的解释。

meaning: r. in a vivid manner
translation_zh: adv. 鲜艳, 强烈, 明亮, 鲜明, 活泼, 有生气, 生动, 清晰, 逼真
example: 他生动地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a mountain formed by volcanic material
translation_zh: n. 火山
example: 这个火山 (noun)为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the amount of 3-dimensional space occupied by an object; n. a publication that is one of a set of several similar publications; n. a relative amount; n. the magnitude of sound (usually in a specified direction)
translation_zh: n. 册, 卷, 体积, 容量, 大量, 许多, 份量, 音量；vi. 成团卷起；vt. 把...收集成卷；a. 大量的；[计] 卷
example: Please turn down the volume on the TV.

meaning: n. a speech sound made with the vocal tract open; n. a letter of the alphabet standing for a spoken vowel
translation_zh: n. 元音；a. 元音的
example: 这个元音为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a journey to some distant place; v. travel on water propelled by wind or by other means
translation_zh: n. 航行, 航海, 航程, 旅行, 航空；vi. 航海, 航行；vt. 航行越过, 飞过
example: 这个旅行为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any of various kinds of wheeled vehicles drawn by an animal or a tractor; n. a child's four-wheeled toy cart sometimes used for coasting
translation_zh: n. 四轮马车, 货车；[法] 囚车, 马车, 运货车
example: 这个四轮的运货马车为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who is under the protection or in the custody of another; n. a district into which a city or town is divided for the purpose of administration and elections; n. block forming a division of a hospital (or a suite of rooms) shared by patients who need a similar kind of care; n. English economist and conservationist (1914-1981)
translation_zh: n. 病房, 守卫, 保卫, 保护, 监护, 牢房, 行政区, 锁孔内的榫舌；vt. 使入病房, 守护, 保卫
example: 这个监视为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a tall piece of furniture that provides storage space for clothes; has a door and rails or hooks for hanging clothes; n. collection of clothing belonging to one person; n. collection of costumes belonging to a theatrical company
translation_zh: n. 衣橱, 衣室, 全部衣服
example: 这个衣柜为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in a warm manner
translation_zh: adv. 亲切地, 温暖地, 热心地
example: 他温暖地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the quality of having a moderate degree of heat
translation_zh: n. 温暖, 温情, 暖和, 激动, 生气
example: I enjoyed the warmth of the sun.

meaning: v. notify of danger, potential harm, or risk; v. admonish or counsel in terms of someone's behavior; v. ask to go away; v. notify, usually in advance
translation_zh: vt. 警告, 提醒, 通知；vi. 发出警告
example: 我们需要逐步warn这个方案。

meaning: n. a message informing of danger; n. notification of something, usually in advance
translation_zh: n. 警告, 预告, 预兆, 通知；[法] 警告, 警戒, 预告; 警告的, 注意的
example: The weather forecast issued a warning for strong winds.

meaning: n a written assurance that some product or service will be provided or will meet certain specifications
translation_zh: n. 正当理由, 授权, 担保, 保证, 根据；[经] 保单, 担保书, 保证书
example: 这个保证为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone engaged in or experienced in warfare
translation_zh: n. 战士, 勇士, 武士, 鼓吹战争的人, 战斗, 尚武
example: 这个战士为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a bathroom sink that is permanently installed and connected to a water supply and drainpipe; where you can wash your hands and face; n a basin for washing the hands (`wash-hand basin' is a British expression)
translation_zh: n. 洗脸盆
example: 这个washbowl（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any materials unused and rejected as worthless or unwanted; n. useless or profitless activity; using or expending or consuming thoughtlessly or carelessly; n. (law) reduction in the value of an estate caused by act or neglect; v. spend thoughtlessly; throw away
translation_zh: n. 浪费, 废物, 损耗, 消耗, 荒地, 垃圾, 地面风化物；a. 废弃的, 荒芜的, 多余的；vt. 浪费, 消耗, 使荒芜；vi. 浪费, 消耗, 变消瘦
example: Don't waste food; eat everything on your plate.

meaning: a. tending to squander and waste; s. laying waste
translation_zh: a. 浪费的, 不经济的
example: It's wasteful to leave the lights on when no one is in the room.

meaning: n. a steep descent of the water of a river
translation_zh: n. 瀑布
example: 这个瀑布为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any of various substances of either mineral origin or plant or animal origin; they are solid at normal temperatures and insoluble in water; v. cover with wax; v. go up or advance; v. increase in phase
translation_zh: n. 蜡, 蜡状物, 一阵发怒, 增加, (月亮)渐盈；vi. 变大, 增大, 月亮渐满；vt. 上蜡于
example: Candles are typically made from wax.

meaning: n. the property of lacking physical or mental strength; liability to failure under pressure or stress or strain; n. the condition of being financially weak; n. a penchant for something even though it might not be good for you
translation_zh: n. 虚弱, 薄弱, 弱点；[经] 欲振乏力
example: His main weakness is his lack of experience.

meaning: n. any instrument or instrumentality used in fighting or hunting; n. a means of persuading or arguing
translation_zh: n. 武器, 兵器；vt. 武装
example: The police found a weapon at the scene.

meaning: n. a digital camera designed to take digital photographs and transmit them over the internet
translation_zh: n. 网络摄像头
example: I use my webcam for video calls.

meaning: s. strikingly odd or unusual; some weird effect of shadow"- Bram Stoker
translation_zh: a. 怪异的, 超自然的, 不可思议的；n. 命运, 预言, 符咒
example: That was a really weird dream I had last night.

meaning: n. the state of being welcome; n. a greeting or reception; v. accept gladly; v. bid welcome to; greet upon arrival
translation_zh: n. 欢迎, 欢迎词；a. 受欢迎的, 可随意的, 可喜的；vt. 欢迎, 接待；interj. 欢迎
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常受欢迎的的解释。

meaning: r. toward the west
translation_zh: n. 朝西的方向；a. 向西的；adv. 向西的
example: They traveled westward across the plains.

meaning: n. a low area where the land is saturated with water
translation_zh: n. 湿地, 沼泽地；[经] 湿地
example: 这个潮湿的土壤为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any of the larger cetacean mammals having a streamlined body and breathing through a blowhole on the head; v. hunt for whales
translation_zh: n. 鲸；vi. 捕鲸；vt. 使惨败, 猛揍
example: 这个鲸为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: adv. & conj. At whatever time.
translation_zh: conj. 每当；adv. 不论何时, 每逢
example: 他究竟什么时候地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r. where in the world
translation_zh: adv. 无论哪里
example: You can sit wherever you like.

meaning: pron. Which (of two); which one (of two); -- used; interrogatively and relatively.; conj. In case; if; -- used to introduce the first or two or; more alternative clauses, the other or others being connected by or, or; by or whether. When the second of two alternatives is the simple; negative of the first it is sometimes only indicated by the particle; not or no after the correlative, and sometimes it is omitted entirely; as being distinctly implied in the whether of the first.
translation_zh: conj. 是否, 不论；pron. 两个中的哪一个
example: 这个是否为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: pron. & a. Alt. of Whichsoever
translation_zh: pron. 无论那一个, 任何一个
example: 这个任何一个为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. speaking softly without vibration of the vocal cords; v. speak softly; in a low voice
translation_zh: n. 耳语, 密谈, 谣传, 沙沙声；vi. 耳语, 密谈, 沙沙地响；vt. 低声说
example: I heard a faint whisper from the next room.

meaning: n. the sound made by something moving rapidly or by steam coming out of a small aperture; n. the act of signalling (e.g., summoning) by whistling or blowing a whistle; n. a small wind instrument that produces a whistling sound by blowing into it; n. acoustic device that forces air or steam against an edge or into a cavity and so produces a loud shrill sound
translation_zh: n. 口哨, 汽笛, 啸啸声, 口哨声；vi. 吹口哨, 鸣汽笛, 发嘘嘘声；vt. 用口哨或吹哨传意, 用口哨演奏
example: 这个口哨为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: pron. Whatever person; any person who; be or she who; any one; who; as, he shall be punished, whoever he may be.
translation_zh: pron. 任何人, 无论谁
example: 这个pro为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. widely circulated or diffused
translation_zh: a. 充分伸展的, 广布的, 普及的, 流传广的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常分布广的的解释。

meaning: n. all living things (except people) that are undomesticated
translation_zh: n. 野生动植物
example: The park is home to diverse wildlife.

meaning: r. to an extreme or greatly exaggerated degree; r. in an uncontrolled or unrestrained manner; r. with violent and uncontrollable passion
translation_zh: adv. 狂暴地, 激动地, 狂热地, 鲁莽地, 轻率地
example: The crowd cheered wildly.

meaning: n. cheerful compliance
translation_zh: n. 乐意, 心甘情愿, 愿意
example: 这个乐意为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n transparent screen (as of glass) to protect occupants of a vehicle
translation_zh: n. 汽车的挡风玻璃
example: The rain splattered against the car's windscreen.

meaning: v ride standing on a surfboard with an attached sail, on water
translation_zh: n. [体]帆板运动
example: 这个windsurfing（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a movable organ for flying (one of a pair); n. one of the horizontal airfoils on either side of the fuselage of an airplane; n. a stage area out of sight of the audience; n. a unit of military aircraft
translation_zh: n. 翅膀, 翼, 机翼, 派别；vt. 给...装上翼, 飞过, 使飞, 空运, 增加...速度；vi. 飞行
example: 这个（鸟、昆虫或蝙蝠的）翅膀为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. ligament made of metal and used to fasten things or make cages or fences etc; n. a metal conductor that carries electricity over a distance; n. the finishing line on a racetrack; v. provide with electrical circuits
translation_zh: n. 电线, 电报, 电信, 铁丝网, 金属丝；vt. 用金属丝捆扎, 拍电报；vi. 打电报
example: Be careful, there's a loose wire sticking out.

meaning: v wither, as with a loss of moisture; v lose freshness, vigor, or vitality
translation_zh: vt. 使凋谢, 使消亡, 使畏缩；vi. 枯萎, 衰退
example: 我们需要逐步wither这个方案。

meaning: n someone who is dazzlingly skilled in any field; n one who practices magic or sorcery; s possessing or using or characteristic of or appropriate to supernatural powers
translation_zh: n. 男巫, 术士, 奇才；a. 男巫的, 巫术的；[计] 向导
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常男巫的解释。

meaning: n. the feeling aroused by something strange and surprising; n. something that causes feelings of wonder; v. have a wish or desire to know something; v. place in doubt or express doubtful speculation
translation_zh: n. 奇迹, 惊奇, 惊愕；vt. 惊奇, 想知道；vi. 惊讶, 怀疑
example: The Grand Canyon is a natural wonder.

meaning: n. a mine or quarry that is being or has been worked; s. actively engaged in paid work; s. adequate for practical use; especially sufficient in strength or numbers to accomplish something; s. adopted as a temporary basis for further work
translation_zh: n. 工作, 运转, 劳动；a. 工作的, 劳动的, 经营的, 抽搐的, 运转的
example: The working of the engine is very smooth.

meaning: n the activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit
translation_zh: n. 试验, 试用, 锻炼
example: I had a great workout at the gym today.

meaning: n. a place where work is done
translation_zh: n. 工作场所, 工厂, 车间
example: Safety is a top priority in the workplace.

meaning: n. small workplace where handcrafts or manufacturing are done; n. a brief intensive course for a small group; emphasizes problem solving
translation_zh: n. 工场, 车间, 研讨会；[计] 讨论会; 专题研究组
example: We attended a workshop on digital marketing.

meaning: a. affected by wear; damaged by long use
translation_zh: a. 用旧的, 穿旧的；wear的过去分词
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常穿旧的的解释。

meaning: n. an indefinite quantity of something having a specified value; n. the quality that renders something desirable or valuable or useful; n. French couturier (born in England) regarded as the founder of Parisian haute couture; noted for introducing the bustle (1825-1895); s. having a specified value
translation_zh: n. 价值, 财产；a. 值...的, 值得的
example: The painting is worth a lot of money.

meaning: s. sufficiently valuable to justify the investment of time or interest
translation_zh: a. 值得花时间的, 值得做的, 有真实价值的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常值得做的的解释。

meaning: n. an important, honorable person (word is often used humorously); a. having worth or merit or value; being honorable or admirable; s. having qualities or abilities that merit recognition in some way
translation_zh: n. 杰出人物；a. 有价值的, 可敬的, 值得的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常应得某事物的解释。

meaning: n. an injury to living tissue (especially an injury involving a cut or break in the skin); n. a casualty to military personnel resulting from combat; n. a figurative injury (to your feelings or pride); n. the act of inflicting a wound
translation_zh: n. 创伤, 伤口, 伤疤, 伤害, 痛苦；vt. 伤害, 损害, 使受伤；vi. 打伤, 伤害；wind的过去式和过去分词
example: 这个创伤为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. cloak that is folded or wrapped around a person; n. a sandwich in which the filling is rolled up in a soft tortilla; v. arrange or fold as a cover or protection; v. crash into so as to coil around
translation_zh: n. 外套, 围巾, 包裹物, 限制, 约束, 秘密, 换行；vt. 包装, 卷, 缠绕, 包, 裹, 覆盖, 遮蔽, 隐藏, 掩护；vi. 缠绕, 穿外衣, 包起来；[计] 换行
example: 这个包为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the covering (usually paper or cellophane) in which something is wrapped
translation_zh: n. 用于包裹的材料；[计] 绕接
example: 这个包装纸为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a joint between the distal end of the radius and the proximal row of carpal bones
translation_zh: n. 手腕, 腕关节；[医] 腕
example: 这个腕为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a watch that is worn strapped to the wrist
translation_zh: n. 手表
example: 这个手表为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. set down in writing in any of various ways; a. systematically collected and written down
translation_zh: a. 书面的, 写成文字的；write的过去分词
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常书面的的解释。

meaning: v. utter or declare in a very loud voice
translation_zh: vi. 叫喊, 大叫, (齐声)呐喊欢呼；vt. 喊叫着说；n. 叫声, 喊声, 呐喊
example: 这个叫喊为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. Hindu discipline aimed at training the consciousness for a state of perfect spiritual insight and tranquility that is achieved through the three paths of actions and knowledge and devotion; n. a system of exercises practiced as part of the Hindu discipline to promote control of the body and mind
translation_zh: n. 瑜珈
example: 这个瑜伽为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. make an itemized list or catalog of; classify; v. make a catalogue, compile a catalogue
translation_zh: n. 目录, 大学情况一览；vt. 编入目录
example: Please refer to the product catalogue for more details.

meaning: n. a natural or artificial enclosed space; n. an enclosed volume in the body; n. a room where a judge transacts business; n. a deliberative or legislative or administrative or judicial assembly
translation_zh: n. 室, 房间, 枪膛；vt. 装(弹药), 把...关在室内；a. 室内的
example: 这个（身体或器官内的）室为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a member of a Catholic church; a. of or relating to or supporting Catholicism; s. free from provincial prejudices or attachments
translation_zh: n. 天主教徒；a. 天主教的, 普遍的, 广泛的, 宽宏大量的
example: 这个广泛的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the people of the Netherlands; n. the West Germanic language of the Netherlands; a. of or relating to the Netherlands or its people or culture
translation_zh: n. 荷兰人, 荷兰语；a. 荷兰的
example: 这个荷兰人的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a model or standard for making comparisons
translation_zh: n. 模板；属性单元；范本（template的复数）
example: 这个样板为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the organization of information according to preset specifications (usually for computer processing); n the general appearance of a publication; v set (printed matter) into a specific format; v determine the arrangement of (data) for storage and display (in computer science); v divide (a disk) into marked sectors so that it may store data
translation_zh: n. 幅度；格式（format的复数）
example: 这个版式为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a short strip of material attached to or projecting from something in order to facilitate opening or identifying or handling it
translation_zh: n. 制表(键), 搭襻, 标号, 调整片, (易拉罐)拉环, 帐单, 标签, 制表符；[计] 标签, 制表符, TAB键
example: Can you open a new tab in your browser?

meaning: v be contingent upon (something that is elided); v have faith or confidence in
translation_zh: v. 依赖；信赖（depend的三单形式）
example: 这个依赖为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n footwear that covers the whole foot and lower leg; n British term for the luggage compartment in a car; n the swift release of a store of affective force; n protective casing for something that resembles a leg; n an instrument of torture that is used to heat or crush the foot and leg; n a form of foot torture in which the feet are encased in iron and slowly crushed; n the act of delivering a blow with the foot; v kick; give a boot to; v cause to load (an operating system) and start the initial processes
translation_zh: n. （英）擦靴的仆役；靴子（boot的复数）
example: 这个长靴为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the act of grasping; n understanding of the nature or meaning or quality or magnitude of something; n power by which something or someone is affected or dominated; n time during which some action is awaited; n a state of being confined (usually for a short time); n a stronghold; n a cell in a jail or prison; n the appendage to an object that is designed to be held in order to use or move it; n the space in a ship or aircraft for storing cargo; v keep in a certain state, position, or activity; e.g., "keep clean"; v have or hold in one's hands or grip; v organize or be responsible for; v have or possess, either in a concrete or an abstract sense; v keep in mind or convey as a conviction or view; v maintain (a theory, thoughts, or feelings); v to close within bounds, limit or hold back from movement; v secure and keep for possible future use or application; v have rightfully; of rights, titles, and offices; v be the physical support of; carry the weight of; v contain or hold; have within; v have room for; hold without crowding; v remain in a certain state, position, or condition; v support or hold in a certain manner; v be valid, applicable, or true; v assert or affirm; v have as a major characteristic; v be capable of holding or containing; v arrange for and reserve (something for someone else) in advance; v protect against a challenge or attack; v bind by an obligation; cause to be indebted; v hold the attention of; v remain committed to; v resist or confront with resistance; v be pertinent or relevant or applicable; v stop dealing with; v lessen the intensity of; temper; hold in restraint; hold or keep within limits; v keep from departing; v take and maintain control over, often by violent means; v cause to stop; v cover as for protection against noise or smell; v drink alcohol without showing ill effects; v aim, point, or direct; v declare to be; v be in accord; be in agreement; v keep from exhaling or expelling
translation_zh: v. 保存；把握（hold的第三人称单数）
example: 这个控制为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a worker who routes shipments for distribution and delivery; n. (computer science) a device that forwards data packets between computer networks; n. a power tool with a shaped cutter; used in carpentry for cutting grooves
translation_zh: [计] 路由器
example: My internet router needs to be reset.

meaning: n a tetravalent nonmetallic element; next to oxygen it is the most abundant element in the earth's crust; occurs in clay and feldspar and granite and quartz and sand; used as a semiconductor in transistors; n a complete metric system of units of measurement for scientists; fundamental quantities are length (meter) and mass (kilogram) and time (second) and electric current (ampere) and temperature (kelvin) and amount of matter (mole) and luminous intensity (candela); n the syllable naming the seventh (subtonic) note of any musical scale in solmization
translation_zh: [计] 国际单位制, 串行接口, 移入；[医] 硅(14号元素,旧名矽)
example: 这个si（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. putting something (as a literary work or a legislative bill) into acceptable form
translation_zh: a. 编辑的
example: 这个编辑的v.编辑( edit的现在分词 )为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a republic in central Europe; the invasion of Poland by Germany in 1939 started World War II
translation_zh: n. 波兰
example: 这个poland（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n an adult female person (as opposed to a man); n a female person who plays a significant role (wife or mistress or girlfriend) in the life of a particular man; n a human female employed to do housework; n women as a class
translation_zh: n. woman的变形；woman 的复数
example: 这个womens（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a soft silver-white ductile metallic element (liquid at normal temperatures); the most electropositive and alkaline metal
translation_zh: [计] 接触起停
example: 这个css（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the body of faculty and students at a university; n establishment where a seat of higher learning is housed, including administrative and living quarters as well as facilities for research and teaching; n a large and diverse institution of higher learning created to educate for life and for a profession and to grant degrees
translation_zh: n. 大学( university的名词复数 )
example: 这个综合性大学为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone (a person or firm) who contracts to build things; n. the bridge player in contract bridge who wins the bidding and can declare which suit is to be trumps; n. (law) a party to a contract
translation_zh: n. （建筑、监造中的）承包人( contractor的复数形式 )
example: 这个(建筑、监造中的)承包人（复数）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a choice that is made by counting the number of people in favor of each alternative; v express one's preference for a candidate or for a measure or resolution; cast a vote; v express one's choice or preference by vote; v express a choice or opinion; v be guided by in voting; v bring into existence or make available by vote
